rows.source: The thickest string is the lowest. It sits nearest your face when you play. We call it string 6.
rows.translation: Najdebelejša struna zveni najnižje. Med igranjem je najbližje tvojemu obrazu. Imenujemo jo struna 6.

rows.source: Each string has a tuning peg on the head. Turning it changes the pitch. Timbre listens and tells you which way.
rows.translation: Vsaka struna ima na glavi svoj ključ za uglaševanje. Z obračanjem spreminjaš višino tona. Timbre posluša in ti pove, v katero smer.

rows.translation: Ubiraj najdebelejšo struno in jo pusti zveneti.

rows.source: E minor uses two fingers on fret 2, strings 5 and 4. Every string rings.
rows.translation: Pri E-molu sta dva prsta na prečki 2, na strunah 5 in 4. Zvenijo vse strune.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-4 “Your first chord: E minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Brush across all six strings from thick to thin, one smooth motion. Keep your wrist loose.
rows.translation: V enem gladkem gibu potegni čez vseh šest strun, od debele do tanke. Zapestje naj bo sproščeno.

rows.source: This challenge mixes the whole unit: the open strings, E, F and G on string 1, and E minor. Take a breath between steps.
rows.translation: Ta izziv združi celo enoto: prazne strune, E, F in G na struni 1 ter E-mol. Med koraki si vzemi čas za vdih.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · challenge gtr-1-5 “First-steps challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: From thick to thin, the open strings are…
rows.translation: Od debele do tanke so prazne strune…

rows.source: Every Amateur Does Get Better Eventually: E A D G B E, string 6 to string 1.
rows.translation: Eva, Ana, danes glejta bele ekrane: E A D G B E, od strune 6 do strune 1.

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: open string 2 is B, fret 2 on string 3 is A, and open string 3 is G. Your second finger plays the A.
rows.translation: Za Mary Had a Little Lamb potrebuješ tri tone: prazna struna 2 je B, prečka 2 na struni 3 je A, prazna struna 3 pa G. A zaigraš z drugim prstom.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · song gtr-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb: three notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3, fret 2, second finger. That's A.
rows.translation: Struna 3, prečka 2, drugi prst. To je A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · song gtr-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb: three notes” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: B A G A B B B: open string 2, then string 3.
rows.translation: B A G A B B B: prazna struna 2, nato struna 3.

rows.translation: Toni na strunah 1 in 2, branje tabulatur in tvoji prvi dve melodiji.

rows.source: String 2 works like string 1. Open, it's B. Fret 1 with your first finger is C. Fret 3 with your third finger is D.
rows.translation: Struna 2 deluje kot struna 1. Prazna zveni B. Prečka 1 s prvim prstom je C. Prečka 3 s tretjim prstom je D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-1 “Three notes on string 2” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Ubiraj prazno struno 2. To je B.

rows.source: String 2, fret 1, first finger. That's C.
rows.translation: Struna 2, prečka 1, prvi prst. To je C.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-1 “Three notes on string 2” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: String 2, fret 3, third finger. That's D.
rows.translation: Struna 2, prečka 3, tretji prst. To je D.

rows.source: One finger per fret: fret 1 gets finger 1, fret 2 gets finger 2, fret 3 gets finger 3.
rows.translation: En prst na prečko: na prečko 1 gre prst 1, na prečko 2 prst 2 in na prečko 3 prst 3.

rows.source: Rest your thumb on the back of the neck, behind your second finger. Your fingers can then arch and land on their tips.
rows.translation: Palec nasloni na zadnjo stran vratu, za drugi prst. Tako lahko prste ukriviš in jih položiš na konice.

rows.source: Tab draws six lines, one per string, with string 1 on top. A number on a line is the fret to press. A 0 means play that string open.
rows.translation: Tabulatura ima šest črt, eno za vsako struno; struna 1 je zgoraj. Številka na črti pove, pri kateri prečki pritisneš. 0 pomeni, da igraš prazno struno.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-2 “Reading tab” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In tab, a 3 on the top line means…
rows.translation: Kaj v tabulaturi pomeni 3 na zgornji črti?

rows.source: The top line is string 1, the thinnest. The number is the fret.
rows.translation: Zgornja črta je struna 1, najtanjša. Številka označuje prečko.

rows.source: A half note rings for two beats. Pick once, count one, two, and let it sustain until the next note.
rows.translation: Polovinka zveni dve dobi. Brenkni enkrat, štej ena, dve in pusti ton zveneti do naslednje note.

rows.source: Half of a four-beat bar is two beats. A quarter note lasts one beat.
rows.translation: Polovica štiridobnega takta sta dve dobi. Četrtinka traja eno dobo.

rows.source: Going from string 2 to string 1 is a tiny move. Keep your picking hand close to the strings so the next note is ready.
rows.translation: Prehod s strune 2 na struno 1 je droben gib. Roko, ki ubira, drži blizu strun, da bo pripravljena na naslednji ton.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Fret 3 on string 2, then open string 1. Lift your finger as you pick.
rows.translation: Prečka 3 na struni 2, nato prazna struna 1. Ob brenku dvigni prst.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: C and D on string 2, then E, F and G on string 1.
rows.translation: C in D na struni 2, nato E, F in G na struni 1.

rows.source: This melody comes from Beethoven's Ninth Symphony. It uses C, D, E, F and G, and it moves mostly one step at a time.
rows.translation: Ta melodija je iz Beethovnove Devete simfonije. Uporablja C, D, E, F in G ter se večinoma premika po en korak.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The first line, slowly: E E F G G F E D.
rows.translation: Prva vrstica, počasi: E E F G G F E D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Then: C C D E E D D.
rows.translation: Nato: C C D E E D D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Each line ends with a lilt: a longer note, a quick one, then a held one. Count one-and-two, and slip the quick note in on the and.
rows.translation: Vsaka vrstica se konča z zibanjem: daljši ton, kratek ton in nato zadržan ton. Štej ena-in-dve in kratek ton vstavi na »in«.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: This nursery tune walks on C, D and E, then jumps up to G. The jump is open string 1 to fret 3.
rows.translation: Ta otroška melodija stopa po C, D in E, nato skoči na G. Skočiš s prazne strune 1 na prečko 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-5 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: E D C D E E E: open string 1, down to string 2 and back.
rows.translation: E D C D E E E: prazna struna 1, navzdol na struno 2 in nazaj.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-5 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: D D D on string 2, then E and G on string 1.
rows.translation: D D D na struni 2, nato E in G na struni 1.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-5 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox
rows.translation: Pod drobnogledom: Pisma v škatli za čevlje

Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-spotlight “Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Letters in a Shoebox is a Timbre Original, a slow ballad in C. Its chorus lives on strings 1 and 2, and its hook opens with the long, short lilt you played in Ode to Joy. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Pesem Pisma v škatli za čevlje je izvirna pesem Timbre, počasna balada v C. Refren je na strunah 1 in 2, značilni motiv pa se začne z dolgim in kratkim tonom kot v Odi radosti. Celotna pesem je v razdelku Pesmi pod Izvirne pesmi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-spotlight “Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The hook: C and D on string 2, then E, F and G on string 1, and back to D.
rows.translation: Značilni motiv: C in D na struni 2, nato E, F in G na struni 1 ter nazaj na D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-spotlight “Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-spotlight “Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: Press with your fingertips, arched like a bridge, so no finger leans on the string below it. Short nails make this much easier.
rows.translation: Pritiskaj s konicami prstov, ukrivljenih kot most, da se ne naslanjajo na spodnjo struno. S kratkimi nohti je to precej lažje.

rows.source: Pick the strings one at a time, thick to thin. A dull thud means a finger is touching that string. Adjust and pick it again.
rows.translation: Ubiraj strune posamično, od debele do tanke. Top udarec pomeni, da se prst dotika te strune. Popravi položaj in znova brenkni.

rows.source: One string sounds dull. What's the likely cause?
rows.translation: Ena struna zveni topo. Kaj je verjeten vzrok?

rows.source: A fingertip leaning on a neighboring string stops it ringing. Arch your fingers more.
rows.translation: Konica prsta, naslonjena na sosednjo struno, ji prepreči zvenenje. Bolj ukrivi prste.

rows.source: Keep your E minor shape and add your first finger on string 3, fret 1. That one note turns minor into major.
rows.translation: Ohrani prijem E-mola in dodaj prvi prst na struno 3 pri prečki 1. Ta ton spremeni mol v dur.

rows.source: Major chords tend to sound bright and settled. Minor chords sound darker. E and E minor differ by just one note.
rows.translation: Durovi akordi navadno zvenijo svetlo in umirjeno. Molovi zvenijo temneje. E in E-mol se razlikujeta le v enem tonu.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-2 “E major: add one finger” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A minor is the E shape moved one string thinner: fingers 2 and 3 on fret 2, finger 1 on string 2, fret 1.
rows.translation: A-mol je prijem E, premaknjen za eno struno proti tanjšim: prsta 2 in 3 na prečki 2, prst 1 na struni 2 pri prečki 1.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The root is the note a chord is named after. In A minor it's open string 5, so start your strum there and skip string 6.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton da akordu ime. Pri A-molu je to prazna struna 5, zato tam začni poteg in izpusti struno 6.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A minor's root is open string 5. Start the strum there.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton A-mola je prazna struna 5. Tam začni poteg.

rows.source: A packs fingers 1, 2 and 3 side by side on fret 2, on strings 4, 3 and 2. Strum from string 5.
rows.translation: Pri A so prsti 1, 2 in 3 drug ob drugem na prečki 2, na strunah 4, 3 in 2. Poteg začni na struni 5.

rows.source: If your fingers feel cramped, slant them so each sits just behind the fret at a slight angle. Keep string 1 clear so it rings.
rows.translation: Če so prsti stisnjeni, jih nagni, da je vsak pod rahlim kotom tik za prečko. Struna 1 naj ostane prosta, da zazveni.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which fret holds all three fingers in A?
rows.translation: Na kateri prečki so vsi trije prsti pri A?

rows.source: From E minor to A minor
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · title

rows.source: Move the shape, not the fingers
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: From E minor to A minor, fingers 2 and 3 hop together to strings 4 and 3. Then finger 1 lands on string 2. Your hand barely moves.
rows.translation: Iz E-mola v A-mol prsta 2 in 3 skupaj skočita na struni 4 in 3. Nato prst 1 pristane na struni 2. Roka se komaj premakne.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Menjaj prej, pristani na prvi dobi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Strum once, then use the rest of the bar to change. Aim to land the new chord right on beat one. Speed comes later, by itself.
rows.translation: Potegni enkrat, nato preostanek takta porabi za menjavo. Novi akord naj zazveni točno na prvi dobi. Hitrost pride pozneje, sama od sebe.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How should your fingers travel between chords?
rows.translation: Kako naj se prsti premikajo med akordi?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Moving the fingers as a unit is faster and lands cleaner. Keep them low, just above the strings.
rows.translation: Skupen premik prstov je hitrejši in omogoči čistejši prijem. Drži jih nizko, tik nad strunami.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Every finger moves from A to E. Picture the E shape before you lift, then move all three together. Aim finger 2 at string 5.
rows.translation: Iz A v E se premaknejo vsi prsti. Pred dvigom si zamisli prijem E, nato premakni vse tri skupaj. Prst 2 usmeri na struno 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-6 “From A to E” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Dust on the Dashboard is a Timbre Original: country in A. Every verse ends on two bars of E and two of A, the change you just learned. See the shape, move early and land on beat one. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Prah na armaturi je izvirna pesem Timbre: country v A. Vsaka kitica se konča z dvema taktoma E in dvema A, pravkar naučeno menjavo. Zamisli si prijem, premakni se prej in pristani na prvi dobi. Celotna pesem je v razdelku Pesmi pod Izvirne pesmi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-spotlight “Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Se to konča na domačem tonu?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-spotlight “Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Over E: open B, open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, C sharp at fret 2, then G sharp at fret 1 on string 3.
rows.translation: Ob E: prazni B, prazni E, D na prečki 3 strune 2, C z višajem na prečki 2, nato G z višajem na prečki 1 strune 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-spotlight “Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: No new ideas: E minor, E, A minor and A. Land each shape cleanly, then keep the changes steady.
rows.translation: Brez novosti: E-mol, E, A-mol in A. Vsak prijem postavi čisto, nato ohranjaj enakomerne menjave.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · challenge gtr-3-7 “Chord-change challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which finger turns E minor into E?
rows.translation: Kateri prst spremeni E-mol v E?

rows.source: Finger 1 on string 3, fret 1 is the one note that makes E major.
rows.translation: Prst 1 na struni 3 pri prečki 1 doda tisti ton, ki ustvari E-dur.

rows.source: Downstrokes, down-up eighths, accents and a strumming hand that never stops.
rows.translation: Udarci navzdol, osminke dol-gor, poudarki in roka, ki se nikoli ne ustavi.

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat. Strum down on every beat and count out loud: one, two, three, four.
rows.translation: Četrtinka traja eno dobo. Na vsako dobo potegni navzdol in glasno štej: ena, dve, tri, štiri.

rows.source: Let the motion come from a loose wrist and forearm, like shaking water off your hand. A stiff arm sounds harsh.
rows.translation: Gib naj izhaja iz sproščenega zapestja in podlakti, kot bi otresal vodo z roke. Toga roka zveni trdo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Koliko četrtinskih potegov zapolni štiridobni takt?

rows.source: Split each beat in two. Strum down on the number and up on the and: one and two and. That's eight strums per bar.
rows.translation: Vsako dobo razdeli na pol. Na številko potegni navzdol, na »in« pa navzgor: ena in dve in. To je osem potegov na takt.

rows.source: Down on the number, up on the and. Your hand goes down and up once per beat.
rows.translation: Na številko navzdol, na »in« navzgor. Roka gre enkrat na dobo dol in gor.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Up strums are naturally softer. Brush just the thinner three or four strings on the way up. That gives the groove its lift.
rows.translation: Potegi navzgor so naravno tišji. Na poti gor se rahlo dotakni le treh ali štirih tanjših strun. To ritmu da lahkotnost.

rows.source: An accent is a note played a little louder. Strum beat one harder than the rest. It tells everyone where the bar begins.
rows.translation: Poudarek je malo glasneje zaigran ton. Na prvo dobo potegni močneje kot na druge. Tako vsi vedo, kje se začne takt.

rows.source: Beat one starts the bar. A slightly louder first strum keeps you, and anyone listening, in time.
rows.translation: Prva doba začne takt. Malo glasnejši prvi poteg pomaga tebi in poslušalcem ohranjati ritem.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Say the bar number on beat one: one, two, three, four; two, two, three, four. You always know where you are.
rows.translation: Na prvo dobo izgovori številko takta: ena, dve, tri, štiri; dve, dve, tri, štiri. Tako vedno veš, kje si.

rows.source: Your strumming hand swings down and up all the time, like a pendulum. To skip a strum, keep swinging and simply miss the strings.
rows.translation: Roka za poteg ves čas niha dol in gor kot nihalo. Če želiš poteg izpustiti, nihaj naprej in se preprosto izogni strunam.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: To skip a strum, your hand…

rows.source: Keeps moving and misses the strings
rows.translation: Se giblje naprej in zgreši strune

Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A hand that never stops keeps steady time. The skipped strum is a swing that doesn't touch the strings.
rows.translation: Roka, ki se ne ustavi, ohranja enakomeren ritem. Izpuščeni poteg je zamah brez dotika strun.

rows.source: This pattern drives countless songs. On beat three your hand swings down without touching the strings, then catches the up strum.
rows.translation: Ta vzorec poganja nešteto pesmi. Na tretjo dobo roka zamahne navzdol brez dotika strun, nato jih ujame s potegom navzgor.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-5 “The folk strum” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In this pattern, which beat has no strum on the number?
rows.translation: Na kateri dobi tega vzorca ni potega na številko?

rows.translation: Na tri roka zamahne navzdol mimo strun, nato na »in« potegne navzgor.

rows.source: Low Tide Radio is a Timbre Original: laid-back reggae on E minor and A. The guitar plays only the ands. Keep your hand swinging down and up, miss the strings on each number and catch every and. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Radio ob oseki je izvirna pesem Timbre: sproščen reggae na E-molu in A. Kitara igra le na »in«. Roka naj niha dol in gor; na vsako številko se izogni strunam, na vsak »in« pa jih ujemi. Celotna pesem je v razdelku Pesmi pod Izvirne pesmi.

rows.source: Where does the guitar play in Low Tide Radio?
rows.translation: Kdaj igra kitara v pesmi Radio ob oseki?

rows.translation: Bas in bobni držijo dobe na številke. Kitara odgovarja med njimi, na »in«.

rows.translation: G se razpre: prst 2 na struni 6, prečka 3; prst 1 na struni 5, prečka 2; prst 3 na struni 1, prečka 3. Zveni vseh šest strun.

rows.source: D lives on the thinnest three strings: finger 1 on string 3, fret 2; finger 3 on string 2, fret 3; finger 2 on string 1, fret 2.
rows.translation: D je na treh najtanjših strunah: prst 1 na struni 3, prečka 2; prst 3 na struni 2, prečka 3; prst 2 na struni 1, prečka 2.

rows.source: A key is a song's home base. In the key of G, the chords G, C and D do most of the work. Countless folk and rock songs use only these three.
rows.translation: Tonaliteta je domače okolje pesmi. V tonaliteti G večino dela opravijo akordi G, C in D. Nešteto folk in rock pesmi uporablja le te tri.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-4 “G, C and D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: You keep landing late on a change. What helps most?

rows.source: A progression is a chord sequence that repeats. A minor, C, G, D starts dark and brightens as it climbs.
rows.translation: Akordično zaporedje se ponavlja. A-mol, C, G, D se začne temno in ob vzpenjanju zveni vse svetleje.

rows.source: Kite Weather is a Timbre Original: bright campfire pop on G, D, E minor and C, around and around. Change early, and land the finger for the lowest string first. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Vreme za zmaje je izvirna pesem Timbre: svetel pop ob tabornem ognju na G, D, E-molu in C, vedno znova. Menjaj zgodaj in najprej postavi prst za najnižjo struno. Celotna pesem je v razdelku Pesmi pod Izvirne pesmi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-spotlight “Song spotlight: Kite Weather” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Kateri akord v pesmi Vreme za zmaje izpusti struni 5 in 6?

rows.source: The verse adds A on string 3, fret 2: the note finger 1 holds in D. Open G, A, then open B.
rows.translation: Kitica doda A na struni 3 pri prečki 2: ton, ki ga pri D drži prst 1. Prazni G, A, nato prazni B.

rows.translation: Brez novosti: C, G, D in D-mol se pridružijo E-molu, E, A-molu in A. Menjaj zgodaj, vleci enakomerno in pusti vsak akord zveneti.

rows.translation: Prazna struna 3 je G. Položi prst 2 na prečko 2 in dobiš A. Pravilo je enako: prst se ujema s prečko.

rows.source: Open string 4 is D. Fret 2 is E and fret 3 is F. Keep your thumb low behind the neck so your fingers can reach.
rows.translation: Prazna struna 4 je D. Prečka 2 je E, prečka 3 pa F. Palec drži nizko za vratom, da prsti dosežejo tone.

rows.source: String 5 fret 3, then strings 4, 3 and 2. Go slowly.
rows.translation: Struna 5, prečka 3, nato strune 4, 3 in 2. Igraj počasi.

rows.translation: Halogen je izvirna pesem Timbre: puščavski rock v D-molu. Riff uporablja pravkar naučene tone: prazni D, F pri prečki 3, prazni G in C na struni 5 pri prečki 3. Celotna pesem je v razdelku Pesmi pod Izvirne pesmi.

rows.translation: Ta mali F uporablja štiri strune. Prst 1 plosko pritisne struni 1 in 2 pri prečki 1, prst 2 gre na struno 3 pri prečki 2, prst 3 pa na struno 4 pri prečki 3.

rows.source: Sharp means one fret higher. G sharp sits between G and A.
rows.translation: Višaj pomeni eno prečko višje. G z višajem leži med G in A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The chorus starts high: G on string 1, fret 3, then F sharp at fret 2.
rows.translation: Refren se začne visoko: G na struni 1 pri prečki 3, nato F z višajem pri prečki 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-4 “D7 and the Clementine chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A seventh chord adds a note that pulls toward home. D7 wants to move to G. Fingers: 2 on string 3, fret 2; 1 on string 2, fret 1; 3 on string 1, fret 2.
rows.translation: Septakord doda ton, ki vleče proti domačemu akordu. D7 želi v G. Prsti: 2 na struni 3, prečka 2; 1 na struni 2, prečka 1; 3 na struni 1, prečka 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-4 “D7 and the Clementine chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: This American ballad from the 1880s needs only G and D7. It's in three, like Amazing Grace. Strum once per bar, then on every beat.
rows.translation: Ta ameriška balada iz 1880-tih let potrebuje le G in D7. Je v tridobnem taktu, kot Amazing Grace. Potegni enkrat na takt, nato na vsako dobo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-4 “D7 and the Clementine chords” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Clementine's melody sits on strings 4, 3 and 2. Its last line uses F sharp again: string 4, fret 4, little finger.
rows.translation: Melodija Clementine je na strunah 4, 3 in 2. Zadnja vrstica znova uporabi F z višajem: struna 4, prečka 4, mezinec.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The opening: G G G, down to open D, up to open B.
rows.translation: Začetek: G G G, navzdol na prazni D, navzgor na prazni B.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D7's extra note leans toward G. When G arrives, the tension lets go.
rows.translation: Dodatni ton v D7 teži h G. Ko pride G, napetost popusti.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The last line: A, open D, F sharp at fret 4, A, then home to G.
rows.translation: Zadnja vrstica: A, prazni D, F z višajem pri prečki 4, A, nato domov na G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · title
Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Ghost Light is a Timbre Original: a slow, dark ballad. Its verse walks A minor, F, C and E, so your mini F gets a song, and the G sharp in E pulls the tune back home. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Luč za duhove je izvirna pesem Timbre: počasna, temna balada. Kitica gre po A-molu, F, C in E, zato mali F dobi svojo pesem, G z višajem v E pa melodijo vleče domov. Celotna pesem je v razdelku Pesmi pod Izvirne pesmi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Listen to the verse's last chord. Major or minor?
rows.translation: Poslušaj zadnji akord kitice. Dur ali mol?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: The ballad strum: one big strum on beat one and let it ring, another on three, then down-up on four. The space after each strum is part of the song.
rows.translation: Baladni poteg: močno potegni na prvo dobo in pusti zveneti, znova na tri, nato dol-gor na štiri. Prostor po vsakem potegu je del pesmi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The verse's last line: open B, C at fret 1, B, G sharp at fret 1 on string 3, B, then open E.
rows.translation: Zadnja vrstica kitice: prazni B, C pri prečki 1, B, G z višajem pri prečki 1 na struni 3, B, nato prazni E.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Guitar · Unit 7 · challenge gtr-7-6 “Songbook challenge” · title

rows.translation: Dve pesmi od začetka do konca
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · challenge gtr-7-6 “Songbook challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: the mini F, D7 and both songs from this unit. Change chords early and let the melodies sing.
rows.translation: Brez novosti: mali F, D7 in obe pesmi iz te enote. Akorde menjaj zgodaj in pusti melodijam peti.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · challenge gtr-7-6 “Songbook challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord pulls hardest toward G?
rows.translation: Kateri akord najmočneje vleče proti G?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · challenge gtr-7-6 “Songbook challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: E7, A7, G7 and B7, sus chords, the shuffle and your first 12-bar blues.
rows.translation: E7, A7, G7 in B7, akordi sus, shuffle in tvoj prvi 12-taktni blues.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 “Seventh and sus chords” · unit summary

Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-1 “E7 and A7” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play E, then lift finger 3 off string 4. The open D that rings is the seventh, a note that adds bluesy tension.
rows.translation: Zaigraj E, nato dvigni prst 3 s strune 4. Prazni D, ki zazveni, je septima, ton, ki doda bluesovsko napetost.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-1 “E7 and A7” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-1 “E7 and A7” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-1 “E7 and A7” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play A, then lift finger 2 off string 3. Open G rings, and A becomes A7.
rows.translation: Zaigraj A, nato dvigni prst 2 s strune 3. Zazveni prazni G in A postane A7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-1 “E7 and A7” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How do you turn E into E7 here?
rows.translation: Kako tukaj spremeniš E v E7?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-1 “E7 and A7” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-2 “G7 and B7” · title
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-2 “G7 and B7” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: G7 keeps the low G but puts F on top: finger 3 on string 6, fret 3; finger 2 on string 5, fret 2; finger 1 on string 1, fret 1.
rows.translation: G7 ohrani nizki G, na vrh pa postavi F: prst 3 na struni 6, prečka 3; prst 2 na struni 5, prečka 2; prst 1 na struni 1, prečka 1.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-2 “G7 and B7” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-2 “G7 and B7” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Build B7 from string 5: finger 2 at fret 2, finger 1 on string 4, fret 1, finger 3 on string 3, fret 2, little finger on string 1, fret 2. String 2 rings open.
rows.translation: B7 zgradi od strune 5: prst 2 pri prečki 2, prst 1 na struni 4 pri prečki 1, prst 3 na struni 3 pri prečki 2, mezinec na struni 1 pri prečki 2. Struna 2 zveni prazna.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-2 “G7 and B7” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord does B7 lead to most naturally?
rows.translation: V kateri akord B7 najnaravneje vodi?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-2 “G7 and B7” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: B7 pulls toward E. Its tension melts into E minor or E.
rows.translation: B7 vleče proti E. Njegova napetost se razreši v E-mol ali E.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-2 “G7 and B7” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-3 “The shuffle” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A shuffle splits each beat unevenly: a long strum down, a short one up. It's the heartbeat of the blues. Think hum-pty, dum-pty.
rows.translation: Shuffle vsako dobo razdeli neenakomerno: dolg poteg navzdol, kratek navzgor. To je srčni utrip bluesa. Predstavljaj si dum-da, dum-da.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-3 “The shuffle” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In a shuffle, each beat splits into…
rows.translation: Pri shufflu se vsaka doba razdeli na…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-3 “The shuffle” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · title
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Many blues songs follow one 12-bar plan. In E: four bars of E7, two of A7, two of E7, then one each of B7, A7, E7 and B7.
rows.translation: Mnoge blues pesmi sledijo isti 12-taktni obliki. V E: štirje takti E7, dva A7, dva E7, nato po en takt B7, A7, E7 in B7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many bars of E7 open the 12-bar blues?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: The last four bars move faster: B7, A7, E7, then B7, which turns you around to the top. Change early and keep the shuffle going.
rows.translation: Zadnji štirje takti se menjajo hitreje: B7, A7, E7, nato B7, ki te obrne nazaj na začetek. Menjaj zgodaj in ohranjaj shuffle.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-5 “Sus chords” · title
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-5 “Sus chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A sus chord swaps the note that makes it major or minor for a neighbor. It sounds open and unresolved until it settles home.
rows.translation: Akord sus zamenja ton, ki določa dur ali mol, s sosednjim. Zveni odprto in nerazrešeno, dokler se ne umiri doma.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-5 “Sus chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-5 “Sus chords” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-5 “Sus chords” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lift finger 2 off string 1 to get Dsus2. For Asus4, play A and add your little finger on string 2, fret 3.
rows.translation: Dvigni prst 2 s strune 1 in dobiš Dsus2. Za Asus4 zaigraj A in dodaj mezinec na struno 2 pri prečki 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-5 “Sus chords” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · title
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Rust Belt Shuffle is a Timbre Original: a 12-bar blues in E, the plan you just strummed, with a swung tune on top. Keep the long-short feel in both hands. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Shuffle rjastega pasu je izvirna pesem Timbre: 12-taktni blues v E, po pravkar odigrani obliki, s swingovsko melodijo. V obeh rokah ohranjaj občutek dolgo-kratko. Celotna pesem je v razdelku Pesmi pod Izvirne pesmi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open G, then G sharp at fret 1 on string 3, then open B: the bluesy slide in bar two.
rows.translation: Prazni G, nato G z višajem pri prečki 1 na struni 3, nato prazni B: bluesovski slide v drugem taktu.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Bar two slides from G to G sharp. Which one belongs to E7?
rows.translation: Drugi takt drsi iz G v G z višajem. Kateri ton pripada E7?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: E7 is E, G sharp, B and D. G is the blue note: it rubs against the chord, then slides into it.
rows.translation: E7 sestavljajo E, G z višajem, B in D. G je bluesovski ton: trenje z akordom nato razreši z drsenjem vanj.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Bar nine, over B7: F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, D sharp at fret 4 on string 2 with your little finger, then B.
rows.translation: Deveti takt, B7: F z višajem pri prečki 2 strune 1, prazni E, D z višajem pri prečki 4 strune 2 z mezincem, nato B.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Guitar · Unit 8 · challenge gtr-8-6 “Blues challenge” · title
Guitar · Unit 8 · challenge gtr-8-6 “Blues challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: seventh chords, sus chords and the 12-bar shuffle. Keep the long-short swing steady through every change.
rows.translation: Brez novosti: septakordi, akordi sus in 12-taktni shuffle. Enakomeren swing dolgo-kratko ohranjaj skozi vsako menjavo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · challenge gtr-8-6 “Blues challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord uses all four fingers?
rows.translation: Kateri akord uporablja vse štiri prste?

rows.source: Power chords, open and movable, palm muting and a riff of your own.
rows.translation: Odprti in premični kvintni akordi, dušenje z dlanjo in tvoj lastni riff.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 “Power chords and riffs” · unit summary

Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A power chord plays only the root and the fifth, the note five letters up. Neither major nor minor, it stays punchy, even loud. E5 is the bottom of E minor.
rows.translation: Kvintni akord vsebuje le osnovni ton in kvinto, ton pet črk više. Ni ne durov ne molov in ostane udaren tudi pri glasnem igranju. E5 je spodnji del E-mola.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Move the same two fingers to strings 4 and 3. With open string 5, that's A5. Aim your strum at strings 5, 4 and 3 only.
rows.translation: Ista dva prsta premakni na struni 4 in 3. S prazno struno 5 je to A5. Poteg usmeri samo na strune 5, 4 in 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which notes make a power chord?

rows.source: Lay the outer edge of your picking hand on the strings, right where they meet the bridge. Strum, and the notes turn short and chunky.
rows.translation: Zunanji rob roke, ki ubira, položi na strune tik ob kobilici. Potegni in toni postanejo kratki in udarni.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Where does your palm rest for palm muting?
rows.translation: Kam nasloniš dlan pri dušenju z dlanjo?

rows.source: At the bridge the strings still sound, just shorter. Move forward and they go dead.
rows.translation: Ob kobilici strune še zvenijo, le krajše. Če dlan premakneš naprej, povsem utihnejo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Rock often builds with muted eighths, then lands on an open chord. Lift your palm for the big strum and let it ring.
rows.translation: Rock pogosto gradi napetost z dušenimi osminkami, nato pristane na odprtem akordu. Za velik poteg dvigni dlan in pusti akord zveneti.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · title
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Finger 1 on string 6, fret 3, then fingers 3 and 4 two frets higher on strings 5 and 4. That's G5. Slide it and the name follows the fret.
rows.translation: Prst 1 na struno 6 pri prečki 3, nato prsta 3 in 4 dve prečki višje na struni 5 in 4. To je G5. Podrsaj prijem in ime sledi prečki.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Your root is on string 6, fret 5. Which power chord is it?
rows.translation: Osnovni ton je na struni 6 pri prečki 5. Kateri kvintni akord je to?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up string 6: E open, F at 1, G at 3, A at 5.
rows.translation: Štej navzgor po struni 6: E prazna, F pri 1, G pri 3, A pri 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: The same shape works from string 5. Finger 1 on string 5, fret 3 gives C5. Let the tip of finger 1 touch string 6 to keep it quiet.
rows.translation: Isti prijem deluje od strune 5. Prst 1 na struni 5 pri prečki 3 da C5. S konico prsta 1 se dotakni strune 6, da ostane tiha.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · title
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A riff is a short, catchy phrase that repeats. This one bounces off open low E. Rest your palm at the bridge to keep it tight.
rows.translation: Riff je kratka, nalezljiva fraza, ki se ponavlja. Ta se odbija od praznega nizkega E. Dlan nasloni ob kobilico, da bo zvok zgoščen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open E, string 6 at fret 3, then open A.
rows.translation: Prazni E, struna 6 pri prečki 3, nato prazni A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: The second bar climbs string 5: fret 2, then fret 5 with your little finger, then back to fret 2. Keep finger 1 parked near fret 2.
rows.translation: Drugi takt se vzpne po struni 5: prečka 2, nato prečka 5 z mezincem, nato nazaj na prečko 2. Prst 1 naj ostane blizu prečke 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 5: fret 2, fret 5 with your little finger, fret 2 again.
rows.translation: Struna 5: prečka 2, prečka 5 z mezincem, znova prečka 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: What makes a riff a riff?
rows.translation: Kaj naredi riff prepoznaven kot riff?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Songs often answer a riff with power chords. Play the riff, then hit the chords on one, the and of two, and four.
rows.translation: Pesmi na riff pogosto odgovorijo s kvintnimi akordi. Zaigraj riff, nato udari akorde na ena, na »in« po dve in na štiri.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-5 “Riffs and power chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Slide G5 up two frets. What do you get?
rows.translation: Podrsaj G5 dve prečki višje. Kaj dobiš?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-5 “Riffs and power chords” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Two frets above G is A. The chord's name moves with its root.
rows.translation: Dve prečki nad G je A. Ime akorda se premakne z osnovnim tonom.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-5 “Riffs and power chords” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Basement Weather is a Timbre Original: garage rock in A. A riff on the low strings opens it, then power chords punch back on one, the and of two, and four. Keep your palm at the bridge. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Kletno vreme je izvirna pesem Timbre: garažni rock v A. Začne jo riff na nizkih strunah, kvintni akordi pa odgovorijo na ena, na »in« po dve in na štiri. Dlan drži ob kobilici. Celotna pesem je v razdelku Pesmi pod Izvirne pesmi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open A, C at fret 3 on string 5, open D, then G at fret 3 on string 6 and open low E.
rows.translation: Prazni A, C pri prečki 3 na struni 5, prazni D, nato G pri prečki 3 na struni 6 in prazni nizki E.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: You know C5, with finger 1 on string 5, fret 3. Slide the whole shape up two frets and it becomes D5. G5 sits at fret 3 too, one string lower than C5.
rows.translation: Poznaš C5 s prstom 1 na struni 5 pri prečki 3. Cel prijem podrsaj dve prečki višje in nastane D5. Tudi G5 je pri prečki 3, eno struno nižje od C5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: No new ideas: power chords, open and movable, palm muting and your riff. Lock in with the click and keep the mutes tight.
rows.translation: Brez novosti: odprti in premični kvintni akordi, dušenje z dlanjo in tvoj riff. Ujemi se s klikom in duši natančno.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · challenge gtr-9-6 “Riff challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Your root is on string 5, fret 3. Which power chord is it?
rows.translation: Osnovni ton je na struni 5 pri prečki 3. Kateri kvintni akord je to?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · challenge gtr-9-6 “Riff challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3.
rows.translation: Struna 5 se vzpenja od A: B pri 2, C pri 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · challenge gtr-9-6 “Riff challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Which one is a power chord?

rows.source: The F barre and B minor, the A minor pentatonic scale and your first solo.
rows.translation: Barré F in B-mol, A-molova pentatonična lestvica in tvoj prvi solo.

rows.source: Full barre chords take weeks, so build up to them. You know the mini F. Next comes a five-string F, then the full barre.
rows.translation: Polni barré akordi zahtevajo tedne, zato jih gradi postopoma. Mali F že poznaš. Sledi F na petih strunah, nato polni barré.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Move finger 3 to string 5, fret 3, and put your little finger on string 4, fret 3. Five strings ring and the F sounds fuller.
rows.translation: Prst 3 premakni na struno 5 pri prečki 3, mezinec pa položi na struno 4 pri prečki 3. Zveni pet strun in F dobi polnejši zvok.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Barre chords feel hard at first. What helps most?
rows.translation: Barré akordi so sprva težki. Kaj najbolj pomaga?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Squeezing as hard as you can
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Strength and feel build slowly. Short, daily practice beats one long, painful session.
rows.translation: Moč in občutek rasteta počasi. Kratka vsakodnevna vadba je boljša kot ena dolga, boleča vaja.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lay finger 1 flat across all six strings at fret 1. Fingers 2, 3 and 4 make an E shape in front of it. F is E moved up one fret.
rows.translation: Prst 1 položi plosko čez vseh šest strun pri prečki 1. Prsti 2, 3 in 4 pred njim tvorijo prijem E. F je E, premaknjen eno prečko višje.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Let your arm's weight pull the barre in, as if gently drawing the neck toward you. Your thumb only steadies. Roll finger 1 onto its side.
rows.translation: Teža roke naj pritegne barré, kot bi vrat nežno vlekel k sebi. Palec le stabilizira. Prst 1 zasukaj na bok.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: The F barre is which open shape, moved up a fret?
rows.translation: Kateri odprti prijem, premaknjen za prečko višje, je barré F?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Finger 1 barres strings 1 to 5 at fret 2. Fingers 2, 3 and 4 build an A minor shape two frets higher. Skip string 6.
rows.translation: Prst 1 naredi barré čez strune 1 do 5 pri prečki 2. Prsti 2, 3 in 4 zgradijo prijem A-mola dve prečki višje. Struno 6 izpusti.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Not ready to barre? Play the top four strings only: fret 4 on strings 4 and 3, fret 3 on string 2, fret 2 on string 1.
rows.translation: Še ne gre z barréjem? Igraj le zgornje štiri strune: prečka 4 na strunah 4 in 3, prečka 3 na struni 2, prečka 2 na struni 1.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord is E moved up one fret with a barre?
rows.translation: Kateri akord je E, premaknjen za prečko višje z barréjem?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The minor pentatonic scale has five notes. In A minor they're A, C, D, E and G. It's the sound of countless blues and rock solos.
rows.translation: Molova pentatonična lestvica ima pet tonov. V A-molu so to A, C, D, E in G. To je zvok neštetih bluesovskih in rockovskih solov.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Finger 1 covers fret 5 on every string. Fingers 3 and 4 take frets 7 and 8. Two notes per string, one finger per fret.
rows.translation: Prst 1 pokriva prečko 5 na vsaki struni. Prsta 3 in 4 prevzameta prečki 7 in 8. Dva tona na struno, en prst na prečko.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Fret 5, fret 8 on string 6, then fret 5, fret 7 on string 5.
rows.translation: Prečka 5, prečka 8 na struni 6, nato prečka 5, prečka 7 na struni 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which notes are in A minor pentatonic?
rows.translation: Kateri toni so v A-molovi pentatoniki?

rows.source: A solo is a melody built from short phrases. Play a few notes, leave a gap, then answer. Ending on A, the root, sounds like a full stop.
rows.translation: Solo je melodija iz kratkih fraz. Zaigraj nekaj tonov, pusti presledek, nato odgovori. Konec na osnovnem tonu A zveni kot pika.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-5 “Your first solo” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which note sounds most like a full stop in A minor?
rows.translation: Kateri ton v A-molu najbolj zveni kot pika?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-5 “Your first solo” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A is the root, the home of A minor. Ending a phrase on it sounds finished.
rows.translation: A je osnovni ton, dom A-mola. Če na njem končaš frazo, zveni zaključeno.

rows.source: Glass Satellites is a Timbre Original: a power ballad on A minor, F, C and G. Your full F barre takes the second chord, and box 1 fits over the whole loop, so it gets a solo. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Pesem Stekleni sateliti je izvirna pesem Timbre: močna balada na A-molu, F, C in G. Polni barré F je drugi akord, vzorec 1 pa ustreza celotni zanki, zato dobi svoj solo. Celotna pesem je v razdelku Pesmi pod Izvirne pesmi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-spotlight “Song spotlight: Glass Satellites” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Over the F chord, which box-1 notes belong to it?
rows.translation: Katera tona iz vzorca 1 pripadata akordu F?

rows.source: F is F, A and C. Box 1 holds A and C, so they sound settled over F.
rows.translation: F sestavljajo F, A in C. Vzorec 1 vsebuje A in C, zato ob F zvenita umirjeno.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-spotlight “Song spotlight: Glass Satellites” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: No new ideas: barre chords, B minor, the pentatonic box and your solo. Breathe, keep the beat, and play it like you mean it.
rows.translation: Brez novosti: barré akordi, B-mol, pentatonični vzorec in tvoj solo. Dihaj, drži ritem in igraj prepričljivo.

rows.translation: Palec na basu, p-i-m-a, Travisovo ubiranje in balada z ubiranjem s prsti.

rows.source: Fingerpicking means plucking with your fingers instead of a pick. Your thumb owns the bass strings, 6, 5 and 4, and plays on the beat like a bass drum.
rows.translation: Pri ubiranju s prsti namesto trzalice uporabljaš prste. Palec prevzame basovske strune 6, 5 in 4 ter igra na dobe kot veliki boben.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-1 “Thumb on the bass” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Thumb only: push down through strings 6, 5 and 4, one at a time.
rows.translation: Samo palec: potisni navzdol skozi strune 6, 5 in 4, vsako posebej.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-1 “Thumb on the bass” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The thumb takes the bass strings. Your fingers take the thinner ones.
rows.translation: Palec prevzame basovske strune. Drugi prsti prevzamejo tanjše.

rows.source: Hold A minor. Your thumb plays the root on string 5, then rocks over to string 4, the chord's fifth. Root, fifth, root, fifth: that's an alternating bass.
rows.translation: Drži A-mol. Palec zaigra osnovni ton na struni 5, nato se zaziba na struno 4, kvinto akorda. Osnovni ton, kvinta, osnovni ton, kvinta: to je izmenični bas.

rows.source: Fingerstyle borrows Spanish names: p for the thumb, i index, m middle, a ring. Rest i on string 3, m on string 2 and a on string 1, ready to pluck.
rows.translation: Pri igranju s prsti uporabljamo španske oznake: p za palec, i za kazalec, m za sredinec, a za prstanec. Pripravi i na struno 3, m na struno 2 in a na struno 1.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-2 “p, i, m and a” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: i, m, a: index on string 3, middle on 2, ring on 1.
rows.translation: i, m, a: kazalec na struno 3, sredinec na 2, prstanec na 1.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-2 “p, i, m and a” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-2 “p, i, m and a” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: p thumb, i index, m middle, a ring. The little finger usually rests.
rows.translation: p palec, i kazalec, m sredinec, a prstanec. Mezinec običajno počiva.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-2 “p, i, m and a” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Each finger plucks up and slightly toward your palm, then relaxes. Keep your hand still above the strings and let the fingers do the moving.
rows.translation: Vsak prst ubere struno navzgor in rahlo proti dlani, nato se sprosti. Roka naj miruje nad strunami, gibanje pa prepusti prstom.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-2 “p, i, m and a” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Travis picking, named after Merle Travis, keeps the thumb alternating on every beat while the fingers pluck in between, on the ands.
rows.translation: Pri Travisovem ubiranju, poimenovanem po Merlu Travisu, palec izmenično igra na vsako dobo, drugi prsti pa ubirajo vmes, na »in«.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In Travis picking, what does the thumb do?
rows.translation: Kaj počne palec pri Travisovem ubiranju?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Alternates bass notes on every beat
rows.translation: Izmenjuje basovske tone na vsako dobo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The thumb is the steady pulse: a bass note on every beat, rocking between two strings.
rows.translation: Palec drži enakomeren utrip: basovski ton na vsako dobo, z izmenjavanjem med dvema strunama.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Keep the thumb going. Between thumb notes, m plucks string 2 and i plucks string 3: thumb, m, thumb, i. Go slowly until it runs by itself.
rows.translation: Palec naj igra naprej. Med njegovimi toni m ubere struno 2, i pa struno 3: palec, m, palec, i. Igraj počasi, dokler ne steče samo od sebe.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Between thumb notes, which finger plucks string 2?
rows.translation: Kateri prst med toni palca ubira struno 2?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: In this pattern m takes string 2 and i takes string 3. The a finger rests for now.
rows.translation: V tem vzorcu m prevzame struno 2, i pa struno 3. Prst a za zdaj počiva.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: When the chord changes, the thumb lands on the new root right on beat one. The fingers keep plucking strings 2 and 3 as before.
rows.translation: Ob menjavi akorda palec pristane na novem osnovnem tonu točno na prvo dobo. Drugi prsti še naprej ubirajo struni 2 in 3 kot prej.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-4 “Travis through the changes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The chord changes. Where does your thumb go?
rows.translation: Akord se zamenja. Kam gre palec?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-4 “Travis through the changes” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-4 “Travis through the changes” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-4 “Travis through the changes” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The bass tells the ear which chord you're on. Landing the root on beat one makes the change clear.
rows.translation: Bas pove ušesu, kateri akord igraš. Osnovni ton na prvo dobo naredi menjavo jasno.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-4 “Travis through the changes” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-4 “Travis through the changes” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Hold each chord for the whole bar so every note rings into the next. Lift a finger only when the next shape needs it.
rows.translation: Vsak akord drži ves takt, da vsak ton zveni v naslednjega. Prst dvigni šele, ko ga potrebuje naslednji prijem.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-4 “Travis through the changes” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-4 “Travis through the changes” · step 7 (along) · title
