Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-5 “A fingerpicked ballad” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: An arpeggio plays a chord one note at a time. This one rolls p, i, m, a, then back down m, i. Six notes fill a bar of three, two to a beat.
rows.translation: Arpeggio zaigra akord ton za tonom. Ta gre p, i, m, a, nato nazaj m, i. Šest tonov zapolni tridobni takt, po dva na dobo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-5 “A fingerpicked ballad” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-5 “A fingerpicked ballad” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: After a plucks string 1, which finger comes next?
rows.translation: Kateri prst sledi, ko a ubere struno 1?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-5 “A fingerpicked ballad” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The roll turns around at the top: p, i, m, a, then m and i on the way back.
rows.translation: Vzorec se na vrhu obrne: p, i, m, a, nato na poti nazaj m in i.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-5 “A fingerpicked ballad” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-5 “A fingerpicked ballad” · step 4 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-5 “A fingerpicked ballad” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: One bar each: A minor, F, C, G, then A minor, F, E, A minor. Your thumb finds each new root: strings 5, 4, 5 and 6.
rows.translation: Po en takt: A-mol, F, C, G, nato A-mol, F, E, A-mol. Palec najde vsak novi osnovni ton: strune 5, 4, 5 in 6.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-5 “A fingerpicked ballad” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-spotlight “Song spotlight: Porchlight” · title
Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-spotlight “Song spotlight: Porchlight” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Porchlight is a Timbre Original: a slow ballad in D. Fingerpick it: your thumb on each chord's root, then i, m and a up strings 3, 2 and 1. Let every note ring into the next. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Luč na verandi je izvirna pesem Timbre: počasna balada v D. Ubiraj s prsti: palec na osnovni ton vsakega akorda, nato i, m in a po strunah 3, 2 in 1. Vsak ton naj zveni v naslednjega. Celotna pesem je v razdelku Pesmi pod Izvirne pesmi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-spotlight “Song spotlight: Porchlight” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In D, which string does your thumb play?
rows.translation: Katero struno pri D igra palec?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-spotlight “Song spotlight: Porchlight” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D's root is open string 4. Strings 5 and 6 stay quiet in this chord.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton D je prazna struna 4. Struni 5 in 6 sta pri tem akordu tihi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-spotlight “Song spotlight: Porchlight” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-spotlight “Song spotlight: Porchlight” · step 3 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-spotlight “Song spotlight: Porchlight” · step 4 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-spotlight “Song spotlight: Porchlight” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Luč na verandi, ubrana s prsti
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-spotlight “Song spotlight: Porchlight” · step 7 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 11 · challenge gtr-11-6 “Fingerpicking challenge” · title
Guitar · Unit 11 · challenge gtr-11-6 “Fingerpicking challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: the alternating bass, p-i-m-a, Travis picking and the ballad. Keep the thumb steady and let every note ring.
rows.translation: Brez novosti: izmenični bas, p-i-m-a, Travisovo ubiranje in balada. Palec naj bo enakomeren in vsak ton naj zveni.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · challenge gtr-11-6 “Fingerpicking challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In p-i-m-a, which letter is the thumb?
rows.translation: Katera črka v p-i-m-a označuje palec?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · challenge gtr-11-6 “Fingerpicking challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Between thumb notes, which finger plucks string 3?
rows.translation: Kateri prst med toni palca ubira struno 3?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · challenge gtr-11-6 “Fingerpicking challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 11 · challenge gtr-11-6 “Fingerpicking challenge” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: The 12-bar in A, the quick change, a boogie bass line, the turnaround and your first blues licks.
rows.translation: 12-taktni blues v A, zgodnja menjava, boogie basovska linija, obrat nazaj in tvoje prve blues fraze.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 “Blues” · unit summary
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Blues chords sit on the first, fourth and fifth notes of the key. In E that's E7, A7 and B7. Move to the key of A and they become A7, D7 and E7.
rows.translation: Bluesovski akordi so na prvem, četrtem in petem tonu tonalitete. V E so to E7, A7 in B7. V tonaliteti A postanejo A7, D7 in E7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of A, which chord does the job B7 did in E?
rows.translation: Kateri akord v tonaliteti A opravi vlogo, ki jo ima B7 v E?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: B7 is five letters up from E. Five letters up from A is E, so E7 takes its place.
rows.translation: B7 je pet črk nad E. Pet črk nad A je E, zato njegovo mesto prevzame E7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Four bars of A7, two of D7, two of A7, then one each of E7, D7, A7 and E7. The last E7 turns you back to the top.
rows.translation: Štirje takti A7, dva D7, dva A7, nato po en E7, D7, A7 in E7. Zadnji E7 te obrne nazaj na začetek.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In a quick change, bar 2 jumps to the four chord and straight back. In A: A7, D7, A7, A7. It adds motion right from the start.
rows.translation: Pri zgodnji menjavi takt 2 skoči na akord četrte stopnje in takoj nazaj. V A: A7, D7, A7, A7. To doda gibanje že na začetku.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In a quick change in A, which chord is bar 2?
rows.translation: Kateri akord je v taktu 2 pri zgodnji menjavi v A?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The four chord in A is D7. The quick change visits it in bar 2, then returns to A7.
rows.translation: Akord četrte stopnje v A je D7. Zgodnja menjava ga obišče v taktu 2, nato se vrne na A7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: The quick change works in any key. In E: E7, A7, E7, E7. Watch for B7 near the end, your four-finger chord.
rows.translation: Zgodnja menjava deluje v vsaki tonaliteti. V E: E7, A7, E7, E7. Proti koncu pazi na B7, akord s štirimi prsti.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A boogie line walks up the chord and back, each note twice, long-short like the shuffle. Over A7 it climbs A, C sharp, E, F sharp, G, then walks back down.
rows.translation: Boogie linija hodi po akordu navzgor in nazaj, vsak ton dvakrat, dolgo-kratko kot shuffle. Ob A7 se vzpne A, C z višajem, E, F z višajem, G, nato se vrne navzdol.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open A, fret 4 on string 5, frets 2 and 4 on string 4, then open G.
rows.translation: Prazni A, prečka 4 na struni 5, prečki 2 in 4 na struni 4, nato prazni G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: How do the two notes of each pair feel?
rows.translation: Kako občutiš tona v vsakem paru?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It's the shuffle again: a long note on the beat, a short one just before the next.
rows.translation: Spet shuffle: dolg ton na dobo, kratek tik pred naslednjo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Move it to D and E
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: The same walk starts from D on string 4 and from E on string 6. Over D7: D, F sharp, A, B, C. Over E7: E, G sharp, B, C sharp, D.
rows.translation: Isti sprehod se začne na D na struni 4 in na E na struni 6. Ob D7: D, F z višajem, A, B, C. Ob E7: E, G z višajem, B, C z višajem, D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 6 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Boogie, A to D and back
rows.translation: Boogie, iz A v D in nazaj
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 8 (along) · title

rows.source: A lick that turns you around
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Bars 11 and 12 often get a turnaround, a short lick that leads back to the top. This one walks down from A to E, one fret at a time.
rows.translation: Takta 11 in 12 pogosto dobita obrat nazaj, kratko frazo, ki vodi na začetek. Ta se spušča iz A v E po eno prečko.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: String 4: fret 4, then 3, then 2. Let the E ring.
rows.translation: Struna 4: prečka 4, nato 3, nato 2. Pusti E zveneti.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where does a turnaround usually go?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The last two bars. It leads the ear back to bar 1 for another time around.
rows.translation: V zadnja dva takta. Uho vodi nazaj v takt 1 za nov krog.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Strum the first ten bars with the quick change, then switch to the lick for bars 11 and 12. That's how a blues band ends each time around.
rows.translation: Prvih deset taktov igraj s potegi in zgodnjo menjavo, nato v taktih 11 in 12 preidi na frazo. Tako bluesovska skupina konča vsak krog.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Your A minor pentatonic box fits right over a blues in A. Its C rubs against the C sharp in A7, and that rub is the sound of the blues.
rows.translation: Tvoj A-molov pentatonični vzorec se prilega bluesu v A. Njegov C se tare ob C z višajem v A7 in to trenje je zvok bluesa.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Over a blues in A, which note sounds most like home?
rows.translation: Kateri ton ob bluesu v A zveni najbolj domače?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A is the root of the key. Licks that end on A sound settled; G and C leave you hanging.
rows.translation: A je osnovni ton tonalitete. Fraze, ki se končajo na A, zvenijo umirjeno; G in C pustita pričakovanje.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 5 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Blues phrases talk to each other. Play lick 1 as the question, then answer with lick 2, which lands on the low A.
rows.translation: Blues fraze se pogovarjajo. Zaigraj frazo 1 kot vprašanje, nato odgovori s frazo 2, ki pristane na nizkem A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 7 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 8 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Neon Laundromat is a Timbre Original: funk that sits on one chord, A7. Its hook slides from C to C sharp, the same rub your blues licks make, and its chorus drops to E7. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Neonska pralnica je izvirna pesem Timbre: funk na enem akordu, A7. Značilni motiv zdrsne iz C v C z višajem, z istim trenjem kot tvoje blues fraze, refren pa se spusti na E7. Celotna pesem je v razdelku Pesmi pod Izvirne pesmi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, then C and C sharp at frets 1 and 2 on string 2, then open E.
rows.translation: A pri prečki 2 na struni 3, nato C in C z višajem pri prečkah 1 in 2 na struni 2, nato prazni E.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Over A7, which note rubs against the chord?
rows.translation: Kateri ton se ob A7 tare z akordom?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A7 is A, C sharp, E and G. C, from your pentatonic box, rubs against its C sharp, and the hook slides from one to the other.
rows.translation: A7 sestavljajo A, C z višajem, E in G. C iz tvojega pentatoničnega vzorca se tare ob njegov C z višajem, značilni motiv pa zdrsne iz enega v drugega.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Neon Laundromat doesn't shuffle. Play your boogie walk in even eighths and it becomes a bass line under the A7: A, C sharp, E, F sharp, G, and back down.
rows.translation: Neonska pralnica nima shuffla. Boogie sprehod igraj v enakomernih osminkah in postane basovska linija pod A7: A, C z višajem, E, F z višajem, G in nazaj navzdol.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 12 · challenge gtr-12-6 “Blues challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: the 12-bar in A and E, the quick change, the boogie line, the turnaround and your licks. Keep the shuffle swinging.
rows.translation: Brez novosti: 12-taktni blues v A in E, zgodnja menjava, boogie linija, obrat nazaj in tvoje fraze. Shuffle naj se ziblje.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · challenge gtr-12-6 “Blues challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In a quick change in E, which chord is bar 2?
rows.translation: Kateri akord je v taktu 2 pri zgodnji menjavi v E?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · challenge gtr-12-6 “Blues challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 12 · challenge gtr-12-6 “Blues challenge” · step 4 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 13 “Lead technique” · title

rows.source: Hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides, bends and vibrato, and a second pentatonic box.
rows.translation: Hammer-on, pull-off, slide, bend in vibrato ter drugi pentatonični vzorec.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 “Lead technique” · unit summary
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A hammer-on sounds a second note with the fretting hand alone. Pick a note, then bring another finger down hard, just behind a higher fret. The string keeps ringing.
rows.translation: Hammer-on ustvari drugi ton samo z roko na vratu. Uberi ton, nato z drugim prstom odločno udari tik za višjo prečko. Struna še naprej zveni.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pick open string 3, then hammer finger 2 onto fret 2. Don't pick the second note.
rows.translation: Uberi prazno struno 3, nato s prstom 2 udari na prečko 2. Drugega tona ne ubiraj.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: String 3: pick fret 5 with finger 1, then hammer finger 3 onto fret 7.
rows.translation: Struna 3: prst 1 drži prečko 5; uberi struno, nato s prstom 3 udari na prečko 7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: What makes a hammer-on ring clearly?
rows.translation: Kaj omogoči čist zvok pri hammer-onu?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A fast, firm landing right behind the fret
rows.translation: Hiter, odločen pristanek tik za prečko
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Speed and aim matter more than force. Land on the fingertip, right behind the fret, and the string keeps singing.
rows.translation: Hitrost in natančnost sta pomembnejši od sile. Pristani na konici prsta tik za prečko in struna bo še pela.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 6 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 7 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A pull-off drops to a lower note. With both fingers down, pick the higher note, then flick the top finger off sideways so it plucks the string as it leaves.
rows.translation: Pull-off se spusti na nižji ton. Ko sta oba prsta na struni, uberi višji ton, nato zgornji prst odmakni vstran, da ob umiku ubere struno.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Fret 2 on string 3, then flick finger 2 off to sound open G.
rows.translation: Prečka 2 na struni 3, nato odmakni prst 2 vstran, da zazveni prazni G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Fingers 1 and 3 on frets 5 and 7. Pick, then pull finger 3 off.
rows.translation: Prsta 1 in 3 na prečkah 5 in 7. Uberi, nato s prstom 3 naredi pull-off.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: In a pull-off, the top finger…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Flicks off sideways, plucking the string
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Lifting straight up lets the note die. A small sideways flick plucks the lower note into life.
rows.translation: Če prst dvigneš naravnost, ton zamre. Majhen odmik vstran ubere nižji ton in ga oživi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: To slide, pick a note and keep pressing as you glide the same finger to a new fret. The pressure carries the sound; only the first note is picked.
rows.translation: Pri slidu uberi ton in ohrani pritisk, medtem ko isti prst zdrsne do nove prečke. Pritisk ohranja zvok; ubereš le prvi ton.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Finger 3 on string 3, fret 7. Pick, then slide up to fret 9 without lifting.
rows.translation: Prst 3 na struni 3 pri prečki 7. Uberi, nato brez dviga zdrsni navzgor do prečke 9.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: During a slide, what keeps the note sounding?
rows.translation: Kaj pri slidu ohranja zvenenje tona?

Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Ease off and the note dies. Keep the same pressure all the way to the new fret.
rows.translation: Če popustiš, ton zamre. Enak pritisk ohrani vse do nove prečke.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Now back: pick fret 9 and slide down to fret 7.
rows.translation: Zdaj nazaj: uberi pri prečki 9 in zdrsni navzdol do prečke 7.

rows.source: A bend pushes the string across the fret to raise its pitch. A whole-step bend, the size of two frets, from fret 7 must sound exactly like fret 9.
rows.translation: Pri bendu potisneš struno počez po prečki, da zvišaš ton. Celotonski bend, velik za dve prečki, mora s prečke 7 zveneti povsem enako kot prečka 9.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3, fret 9: this is your bend target. Let it ring and remember it.
rows.translation: Struna 3, prečka 9: to je cilj tvojega benda. Pusti ton zveneti in si ga zapomni.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Put finger 3 on fret 7 with fingers 1 and 2 behind it on the same string. Push all three toward the ceiling, turning your wrist as if turning a doorknob.
rows.translation: Prst 3 položi na prečko 7, prsta 1 in 2 pa za njim na isto struno. Vse tri potisni proti stropu in zavrti zapestje, kot bi obračal kljuko.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Your bend from fret 7 sounds lower than fret 9. What now?
rows.translation: Tvoj bend s prečke 7 zveni nižje od prečke 9. Kaj zdaj?

rows.source: A bend that falls short sounds sour. Push until it matches the target you heard.
rows.translation: Bend, ki ne doseže cilja, zveni nečisto. Potiskaj, dokler se ne ujema s slišanim ciljnim tonom.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Target, then a short bend. Same note or different?
rows.translation: Ciljni ton, nato prenizek bend. Isti ton ali različen?

rows.source: Vibrato is a small bend and release, repeated quickly on a held note. Keep it narrow and even so the note stays in tune.
rows.translation: Vibrato je majhen bend in popustitev, hitro ponavljana na zadržanem tonu. Naj bo ozek in enakomeren, da ton ostane uglašen.

rows.source: The same five notes repeat up the neck. Box 2 starts where box 1 ends: finger 1 at fret 7 on strings 5, 4 and 3, finger 2 at fret 8 on strings 6, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Istih pet tonov se ponavlja po vratu navzgor. Vzorec 2 se začne, kjer se vzorec 1 konča: prst 1 pri prečki 7 na strunah 5, 4 in 3, prst 2 pri prečki 8 na strunah 6, 2 in 1.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 6: frets 8 and 10. String 5: frets 7 and 10.
rows.translation: Struna 6: prečki 8 in 10. Struna 5: prečki 7 in 10.

rows.source: The same five notes as box 1, A C D E G, in a new place on the neck.
rows.translation: Istih pet tonov kot v vzorcu 1, A C D E G, na novem mestu na vratu.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: To travel from box 1 to box 2, slide finger 3 from fret 7 to fret 9 on string 3. You arrive in box 2 with your hand already in place.
rows.translation: Iz vzorca 1 v vzorec 2 preideš tako, da s prstom 3 zdrsneš od prečke 7 do prečke 9 na struni 3. V vzorec 2 prispeš z roko že na pravem mestu.

rows.source: Saltwater Sunday is a Timbre Original: laid-back reggae in A minor, where Am7 and D7 trade bars. Both pentatonic boxes fit over them. Hammer, pull and slide, and land on a chord note as each bar begins. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Nedelja ob morju je izvirna pesem Timbre: sproščen reggae v A-molu, kjer Am7 in D7 izmenjujeta takte. Oba pentatonična vzorca se prilegata. Uporabi hammer-on, pull-off in slide ter vsak takt začni na akordnem tonu. Celotna pesem je v razdelku Pesmi pod Izvirne pesmi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Over D7, which of these box notes belongs to the chord?
rows.translation: Kateri od teh tonov vzorca pripada akordu D7?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D7 is D, F sharp, A and C. C, its seventh, sounds settled; E and G only pass through.
rows.translation: D7 sestavljajo D, F z višajem, A in C. Njegova septima C zveni umirjeno; E in G sta le prehodna tona.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: No new ideas: hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides, bend targets, vibrato and both boxes. Play each phrase cleanly, then make it sing.
rows.translation: Brez novosti: hammer-on, pull-off, slide, ciljni toni bendov, vibrato in oba vzorca. Vsako frazo zaigraj čisto, nato naj zapoje.

rows.source: Your F barre is an E shape with a barre at fret 1. Slide the whole thing up and the name follows the root on string 6: at fret 3 it's G, at fret 5 it's A.
rows.translation: Tvoj barré F je prijem E z barréjem pri prečki 1. Cel prijem podrsaj višje in ime sledi osnovnemu tonu na struni 6: pri prečki 3 je G, pri prečki 5 pa A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: An E-shape barre at fret 5. Which chord?
rows.translation: Barré s prijemom E pri prečki 5. Kateri akord?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: String 6 counts up from E: F at 1, G at 3, A at 5. The barre's fret names the chord.
rows.translation: Struna 6 se vzpenja od E: F pri 1, G pri 3, A pri 5. Prečka barréja poimenuje akord.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lift finger 2 and let the barre cover string 3. That's the E minor shape, and it moves the same way: F sharp minor at fret 2, A minor at fret 5.
rows.translation: Dvigni prst 2 in prepusti struno 3 barréju. To je prijem E-mola in premika se enako: mol na F z višajem pri prečki 2, A-mol pri prečki 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · title

rows.translation: Prijem A, osnovni ton na struni 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: B minor was an A minor shape with a barre. The major A shape moves too: barre strings 1 to 5, then lay finger 3 flat across strings 4, 3 and 2, two frets higher.
rows.translation: B-mol je bil prijem A-mola z barréjem. Premika se tudi durovi prijem A: naredi barré čez strune 1 do 5, nato prst 3 plosko položi čez strune 4, 3 in 2 dve prečki višje.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: An A-shape barre at fret 3. Which chord?
rows.translation: Barré s prijemom A pri prečki 3. Kateri akord?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3, D at 5.
rows.translation: Struna 5 se vzpenja od A: B pri 2, C pri 3, D pri 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The minor A shape moves too
rows.translation: Tudi molov prijem A se premika
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: For minor, use your B minor fingers: 2, 3 and 4 build the A minor pattern in front of the barre. At fret 3 that's C minor.
rows.translation: Za mol uporabi prste kot pri B-molu: 2, 3 in 4 pred barréjem tvorijo prijem A-mola. Pri prečki 3 je to C-mol.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Most chords can be an E shape, root on string 6, or an A shape, root on string 5. Pick whichever sits closer to where your hand already is.
rows.translation: Večino akordov lahko igraš s prijemom E, z osnovnim tonom na struni 6, ali s prijemom A, z osnovnim tonom na struni 5. Izberi tistega, ki je bližje tvoji roki.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: You're playing G at fret 3. Where's the closest C?
rows.translation: Igraš G pri prečki 3. Kje je najbližji C?

rows.source: C's root is on string 5, fret 3. Stay at fret 3 and switch to the A shape.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton C je na struni 5 pri prečki 3. Ostani pri prečki 3 in preidi na prijem A.

rows.source: From G to C at fret 3, finger 1 stays on the barre. Only the fingers in front of it change. It's the smoothest barre change there is.
rows.translation: Iz G v C pri prečki 3 prst 1 ostane na barréju. Zamenjajo se le prsti pred njim. To je najgladkejša menjava barré akordov.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D as an A shape sits at which fret?
rows.translation: Pri kateri prečki je D s prijemom A?

rows.translation: Struna 5: prazni A, B pri 2, C pri 3, D pri 5.

rows.source: F sharp minor, D, A and E all live in the key of A. Start with F sharp minor as a barre and the other three open.
rows.translation: Mol na F z višajem, D, A in E pripadajo tonaliteti A. Začni z barréjem za mol na F z višajem, druge tri pa igraj odprte.

rows.translation: Struna 6: F pri prečki 1, F z višajem pri prečki 2.

rows.translation: Igraj višje po vratu: mol na F z višajem pri prečki 2, D s prijemom A pri prečki 5, A s prijemom E pri prečki 5 in E s prijemom A pri prečki 7.

rows.source: Let the barre go soft for an instant as you move, then squeeze as you land. Gripping hard all the way tires your hand and slows the change.
rows.translation: Med premikom za hip popusti barré, nato ob pristanku pritisni. Če ves čas močno stiskaš, se roka utrudi in menjava upočasni.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: When should your fretting hand squeeze?
rows.translation: Kdaj naj roka na vratu pritisne?

rows.source: Squeeze to land, relax to move. Constant force wears out your hand in minutes.
rows.translation: Za pristanek pritisni, za premik popusti. Stalen napor v nekaj minutah izčrpa roko.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: On the last up strum before a change, lift the barre and keep strumming. The open strings sound for a moment, the rhythm never stops, and you land on time.
rows.translation: Pri zadnjem potegu navzgor pred menjavo dvigni barré in nadaljuj poteg. Za hip zazvenijo prazne strune, ritem se ne ustavi in ti pristaneš pravočasno.

rows.translation: Zora iz spreja je izvirna pesem Timbre: indie pop v E na E, B, molu na C z višajem in A. B in mol na C z višajem sta barréja s prijemom A, dve prečki narazen, zato en prijem opravi večino dela. Celotna pesem je v razdelku Pesmi pod Izvirne pesmi.

rows.source: Funk sixteenths and scratches, the reggae chop, country boom-chick and a syncopated pop strum.
rows.translation: Funkovske šestnajstinke in dušeni udarci, reggae udarec, country bum-čik in sinkopirani pop potegi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 “Rhythm styles” · unit summary
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · title
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Sixteenth notes split each beat in four: one-e-and-a, two-e-and-a. Your strumming hand doubles its speed, down-up-down-up inside every beat.
rows.translation: Šestnajstinke razdelijo vsako dobo na štiri: en-e-in-a, dva-e-in-a. Roka za poteg podvoji hitrost: dol-gor-dol-gor v vsaki dobi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many sixteenth notes fill one beat?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: One-e-and-a: four even slices of every beat.
rows.translation: En-e-in-a: štirje enaki deli vsake dobe.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Funk loves the ninth chord. Finger 2 on string 5, fret 7, finger 1 on string 4, fret 6, and finger 3 flat across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 7.
rows.translation: Funk obožuje nonakord. Prst 2 na struno 5 pri prečki 7, prst 1 na struno 4 pri prečki 6, prst 3 pa plosko čez strune 3, 2 in 1 pri prečki 7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · title
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Keep your hand moving in sixteenths, but relax your fretting fingers so most strums are dead, scratchy clicks. Press down only for the hits.
rows.translation: Roka naj se giblje v šestnajstinkah, prsti na vratu pa naj bodo sproščeni, da je večina potegov suhih, praskajočih klikov. Pritisni le za zveneče udarce.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Fretting fingers resting lightly on the strings
rows.translation: Prsti na vratu se rahlo dotikajo strun
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Touching without pressing stops the strings from ringing. The strum turns into a crisp, percussive click.
rows.translation: Dotik brez pritiska ustavi zvenenje strun. Poteg se spremeni v jasen, udaren klik.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Squeeze for each hit, then relax right away so it stays short. Slide the whole E9 shape down two frets and you have D9.
rows.translation: Za vsak udarec pritisni, nato takoj popusti, da ostane kratek. Celoten prijem E9 podrsaj dve prečki nižje in dobiš D9.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Reggae: kratek udarec na šibko dobo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · title
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Reggae guitar answers the drums with short, bright chords on beats two and four. Strum just the thin strings and cut each chord off right away.
rows.translation: Reggae kitara odgovarja bobnom s kratkimi, svetlimi akordi na drugi in četrti dobi. Potegni le po tankih strunah in vsak akord takoj prekini.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Use the top four strings only. This A minor is the top of your A minor barre at fret 5: finger 3 on string 4, fret 7, finger 1 barring the rest.
rows.translation: Uporabi le zgornje štiri strune. Ta A-mol je vrh tvojega barréja A-mola pri prečki 5: prst 3 na struni 4 pri prečki 7, prst 1 pa naredi barré čez preostale.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How long should a reggae chop ring?
rows.translation: Kako dolgo naj zveni kratek reggae udarec?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Squeeze, strum, release. The chop is a short bark, and the space after it is the groove.
rows.translation: Pritisni, potegni, popusti. Udarec je kot kratek lajež, prostor za njim pa daje ritmu občutek.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now the top of your D barre: finger 3 flat across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 7, finger 1 on string 1 at fret 5.
rows.translation: Zdaj vrh tvojega barréja D: prst 3 plosko čez strune 4, 3 in 2 pri prečki 7, prst 1 na struni 1 pri prečki 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · title
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Country rhythm splits the bar: a single bass note on beats one and three, a quick strum of the thin strings on two and four. Boom, chick, boom, chick.
rows.translation: Country ritem razdeli takt: en basovski ton na prvo in tretjo dobo, hiter poteg po tankih strunah na drugo in četrto. Bum, čik, bum, čik.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: In boom-chick, what happens on beats two and four?
rows.translation: Kaj se pri bum-čiku zgodi na drugo in četrto dobo?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A short strum of the thin strings
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Move the second boom to another string: in G, string 6 then string 4. In C, string 5 then 4. In D, string 4 then open string 5.
rows.translation: Drugi bum prestavi na drugo struno: v G struna 6, nato struna 4. V C struna 5, nato 4. V D struna 4, nato prazna struna 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Booms in G, C and D
rows.translation: Basovski udarci v G, C in D
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 6 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · title
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Syncopation puts the strum where you don't expect it. Down on one, up on the and of two, up on the and of three, then down-up on four.
rows.translation: Sinkopa postavi poteg tja, kjer ga ne pričakuješ. Navzdol na ena, navzgor na »in« po dve, navzgor na »in« po tri, nato dol-gor na štiri.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In this pattern, what does your hand do on beat two?
rows.translation: Kaj v tem vzorcu roka naredi na drugo dobo?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The pendulum never stops. On two the hand swings down without touching, ready for the up strum.
rows.translation: Nihalo se nikoli ne ustavi. Na dve roka zamahne navzdol brez dotika strun, pripravljena na poteg navzgor.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pop players often change chords on the last up strum, the and of four, so the new chord arrives a hair early. It pushes the song forward.
rows.translation: Pop glasbeniki pogosto menjajo akorde na zadnji poteg navzgor, na »in« po štiri, da novi akord prispe za las prej. To pesem potisne naprej.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · title

rows.source: The pop strum on four chords
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Sparkler Season is a Timbre Original: a summer anthem in C on C, G, A minor and F. Give it the syncopated pop strum, and change a hair early, on the and of four. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Čas iskric je izvirna pesem Timbre: poletna himna v C na C, G, A-molu in F. Igraj sinkopirane pop potege in menjaj za las prej, na »in« po štiri. Celotna pesem je v razdelku Pesmi pod Izvirne pesmi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open E and D at fret 3 on string 2, twice, then G at fret 3 on string 1, and back down to D.
rows.translation: Prazni E in D pri prečki 3 na struni 2, dvakrat, nato G pri prečki 3 na struni 1 in nazaj navzdol na D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Why change chords on the and of four?
rows.translation: Zakaj akord zamenjaš na »in« po štiri?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: So the new chord rings on beat one
rows.translation: Da novi akord zveni na prvo dobo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Moving on the last up strum gets your hand there a hair early, so the new chord is ready for beat one.
rows.translation: Premik na zadnji poteg navzgor pripelje roko na mesto za las prej, zato je novi akord pripravljen na prvo dobo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · title
Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: funk sixteenths, the reggae chop, boom-chick and the syncopated pop strum. Keep the hand swinging and change only what it hits.
rows.translation: Brez novosti: funkovske šestnajstinke, kratki reggae udarci, bum-čik in sinkopirani pop potegi. Roka naj niha; spreminjaj le, kaj zadene.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Reggae chops land on which beats?
rows.translation: Na katere dobe padejo kratki reggae udarci?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 16 “Putting it together” · title

rows.source: A capo, G and D shapes on capo 2, and Oh! Susanna arranged with a verse and a chorus.
rows.translation: Kapodaster, prijema G in D pri kapodastru na 2 ter Oh! Susanna, prirejena s kitico in refrenom.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 “Putting it together” · unit summary
Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · title
Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A capo clamps every string at one fret. On fret 2, each open string sounds two frets higher, and your open chord shapes all move up with it.
rows.translation: Kapodaster stisne vse strune pri eni prečki. Pri prečki 2 vsaka prazna struna zveni dve prečki višje, z njim pa se zvišajo vsi odprti prijemi akordov.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Before the capo: pluck strings 1 and 2 open. That's E and B.
rows.translation: Pred kapodastrom: uberi prazni struni 1 in 2. To sta E in B.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Now clamp the capo just behind fret 2 and pluck them again: F sharp and C sharp.
rows.translation: Zdaj pripni kapodaster tik za prečko 2 in ju spet uberi: F z višajem in C z višajem.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Capo on fret 2. You play a G shape. Which chord sounds?
rows.translation: Kapodaster pri prečki 2. Igraš prijem G. Kateri akord zveni?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Two frets up from G is A. The shape stays G; the sound moves up with the capo.
rows.translation: Dve prečki nad G je A. Prijem ostane G, zvok pa se s kapodastrom zviša.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: With a capo you still think G, C and D, the shapes you know. The diagrams here name the chord you actually hear, so a G shape on capo 2 reads A.
rows.translation: S kapodastrom še vedno misliš G, C in D, znane prijeme. Tukajšnji diagrami poimenujejo akord, ki ga res slišiš, zato je prijem G pri kapodastru na 2 označen A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G and D shapes on capo 2
rows.translation: Prijema G in D, kapodaster na 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · title

rows.source: The G family, two frets up
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: On capo 2, G, C, D and E minor shapes sound as A, D, E and F sharp minor. Same fingers, new key: A major.
rows.translation: Pri kapodastru na 2 prijemi G, C, D in E-mol zvenijo kot A, D, E in mol na F z višajem. Isti prsti, nova tonaliteta: A-dur.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Capo on fret 2. A D shape sounds as…
rows.translation: Kapodaster pri prečki 2. Prijem D zveni kot…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Two frets above D is E.
rows.translation: Dve prečki nad D je E.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: D shapes work the same way. On capo 2, D, G and A shapes sound as E, A and B: the key of E with easy open fingerings.
rows.translation: Prijemi D delujejo enako. Pri kapodastru na 2 prijemi D, G in A zvenijo kot E, A in B: tonaliteta E z lahkimi odprtimi prijemi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · title
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Most songs alternate two sections. The verse tells the story; the chorus repeats the hook. Stephen Foster's Oh! Susanna (1848) has both. Capo off: it's in G.
rows.translation: Večina pesmi izmenjuje dva dela. Kitica pripoveduje zgodbo, refren ponavlja značilni motiv. Oh! Susanna (1848) Stephena Fosterja ima oba. Snemi kapodaster: pesem je v G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The pickup and first bar: open G, A at fret 2, then open B, D at fret 3 twice, and open E.
rows.translation: Predtakt in prvi takt: prazni G, A pri prečki 2, nato prazni B, dvakrat D pri prečki 3 in prazni E.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which section usually comes back with the same words?
rows.translation: Kateri del se običajno vrne z istim besedilom?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Verses change their words as the story moves on. The chorus returns unchanged, and that's what people sing along to.
rows.translation: Kitice spreminjajo besedilo, ko zgodba napreduje. Refren se vrne nespremenjen in prav tega ljudje pojejo zraven.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Back the verse with G and D7, boom-chick style: bass on one, strum on two. Three bars of G, one of D7, two of G, then D7 and G.
rows.translation: Kitico spremljaj z G in D7 v slogu bum-čik: bas na ena, poteg na dve. Trije takti G, en D7, dva G, nato D7 in G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 8 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · title
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The chorus opens on C, string 2, fret 1, then jumps to open E. Its chords are C, G and D7, and its second half matches the verse's ending.
rows.translation: Refren se začne na C, struna 2, prečka 1, nato skoči na prazni E. Njegovi akordi so C, G in D7, druga polovica pa je enaka koncu kitice.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The opening: C twice on string 2, fret 1, then open E three times.
rows.translation: Začetek: dvakrat C na struni 2 pri prečki 1, nato trikrat prazni E.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Then down: D twice, open B, open G, and A at fret 2.
rows.translation: Nato navzdol: dvakrat D, prazni B, prazni G in A pri prečki 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The three E's go short, long, short. Where does the long one start?
rows.translation: Trije E gredo kratko, dolgo, kratko. Kje se začne dolgi?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It starts on the and and rings across the next beat. That push is syncopation, like your pop strum.
rows.translation: Začne se na »in« in zveni čez naslednjo dobo. Ta potisk je sinkopa, kot pri tvojih pop potegih.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · title
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: An arrangement decides what you play, and when. Yours: a Travis-picked intro, the verse as melody, the chorus strummed boom-chick, then the chorus melody to finish.
rows.translation: Priredba določi, kaj igraš in kdaj. Tvoja: uvod s Travisovim ubiranjem, melodija kitice, refren s potegi bum-čik in na koncu melodija refrena.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 2 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Sets the key and tempo before the melody
rows.translation: Pred melodijo postavi tonaliteto in tempo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A few bars of chords tell everyone where home is and how fast to go.
rows.translation: Nekaj taktov akordov vsem pove, kje je dom in kako hitro naj gredo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 4 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Finish with the chorus melody and let the last G ring. Ending on the tune everyone just heard feels complete.
rows.translation: Končaj z melodijo refrena in pusti zadnji G zveneti. Zaključek z melodijo, ki so jo pravkar vsi slišali, deluje celovito.

rows.source: Gravel Road Two-Step is a Timbre Original: dance-hall country in A, on A, D and E. Clamp the capo on fret 2 and play it with G, C and D shapes, the ones you know best. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Two-step po makadamu je izvirna pesem Timbre: plesni country v A na A, D in E. Kapodaster pripni pri prečki 2 in igraj s prijemi G, C in D, ki jih najbolje poznaš. Celotna pesem je v razdelku Pesmi pod Izvirne pesmi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-spotlight “Song spotlight: Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Capo on fret 2. Which shape sounds as E?
rows.translation: Kapodaster pri prečki 2. Kateri prijem zveni kot E?

rows.source: Two frets above D is E. On capo 2 the G shape gives A, and the C shape gives D.
rows.translation: Dve prečki nad D je E. Pri kapodastru na 2 prijem G da A, prijem C pa D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-spotlight “Song spotlight: Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Pick the chord's root on beats one and three, and strum on two and four, each with a quick up after it. Boom, chick-a, boom, chick-a: the dancers' steps.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton akorda uberi na prvo in tretjo dobo, na drugo in četrto pa potegni, vsakič s hitrim potegom navzgor za njim. Bum, čik-a, bum, čik-a: plesni koraki.

rows.source: No new ideas: the capo, G and D shapes, and your Oh! Susanna arrangement. Play it as if someone's listening. Maybe someone is.
rows.translation: Brez novosti: kapodaster, prijema G in D ter tvoja priredba Oh! Susanna. Igraj, kot da te kdo posluša. Morda te res.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · challenge gtr-16-6 “Final showcase” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Five open shapes become five places to play G, and chords that stay near your hand.
rows.translation: Pet odprtih prijemov postane pet mest za G in akordi, ki ostanejo blizu tvoje roke.

rows.source: Every major chord can borrow the shape of open C, A, G, E or D, moved up the neck. Climbing from any one, the shapes come in that order, C A G E D, and each locks onto the next.
rows.translation: Vsak durov akord si lahko izposodi prijem odprtega C, A, G, E ali D, premaknjen višje po vratu. Od kateregakoli naprej si prijemi sledijo v vrstnem redu C A G E D in vsak se poveže z naslednjim.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: C, A, G, E and D: the five open shapes that every major chord can borrow, anywhere on the neck.
rows.translation: C, A, G, E in D: pet odprtih prijemov, ki si jih lahko izposodi vsak durov akord kjerkoli na vratu.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Climb from open G and the next shape is the E shape: your G barre at fret 3. Its root on string 6 is the same G as in the open chord.
rows.translation: Vzpenjaj se od odprtega G in sledi prijem E: tvoj barré G pri prečki 3. Njegov osnovni ton na struni 6 je isti G kot v odprtem akordu.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open D moved up five frets is G. Finger 1 holds string 4 at fret 5, where the nut used to be. Fingers 2, 4 and 3 rebuild the D triangle above it.
rows.translation: Odprti D, premaknjen pet prečk višje, je G. Prst 1 drži struno 4 pri prečki 5 in nadomesti zgornje sedlo. Prsti 2, 4 in 3 nad njim znova oblikujejo trikotnik D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The D shape, string by string
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Where is the D shape's root?
rows.translation: Kje je osnovni ton prijema D?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Open D's root is open string 4. Moved up, finger 1 holds it: G at fret 5. String 2, fret 8 is a G too.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton odprtega D je prazna struna 4. Višje ga drži prst 1: G pri prečki 5. Tudi struna 2 pri prečki 8 je G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: The E shape at fret 3 and the D shape at fret 5 share one note: G on string 4, fret 5. Keep your eyes on it as you move between them.
rows.translation: Prijem E pri prečki 3 in prijem D pri prečki 5 imata skupni ton: G na struni 4 pri prečki 5. Med prehodom ga spremljaj z očmi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Open C moved up seven frets is G. Finger 1 lies across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 7, finger 2 takes string 2 at fret 8, and fingers 3 and 4 stretch to strings 4 and 5.
rows.translation: Odprti C, premaknjen sedem prečk višje, je G. Prst 1 leži čez strune 3, 2 in 1 pri prečki 7, prst 2 prevzame struno 2 pri prečki 8, prsta 3 in 4 pa se raztegneta do strun 4 in 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The C shape, string by string
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Like open C, the C shape's root is on…
rows.translation: Kot pri odprtem C je osnovni ton prijema C na…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Open C's root is string 5, fret 3. Here your little finger holds it: G at fret 10.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton odprtega C je struna 5 pri prečki 3. Tukaj ga drži mezinec: G pri prečki 10.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Slide the C shape down to fret 2 and it's D, with its root on string 5, fret 5. The name always follows the root.
rows.translation: Prijem C podrsaj navzdol do prečke 2 in dobiš D, z osnovnim tonom na struni 5 pri prečki 5. Ime vedno sledi osnovnemu tonu.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The A shape, and around again
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · title
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Barre strings 5 to 1 at fret 10 and lay finger 3 across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 12. It's your A-shape barre, and it's G again.
rows.translation: Naredi barré čez strune 5 do 1 pri prečki 10 in položi prst 3 čez strune 4, 3 in 2 pri prečki 12. To je tvoj barré s prijemom A in spet je G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Past the A shape, the G shape comes back at fret 12: open G, one octave higher. From there the five shapes repeat in the same order.
rows.translation: Za prijemom A se pri prečki 12 vrne prijem G: odprti G, oktavo višje. Od tam se pet prijemov ponavlja v istem vrstnem redu.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Going up the neck, which shape comes after A?
rows.translation: Kateri prijem po vratu navzgor sledi prijemu A?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The order loops: C, A, G, E, D, then C again. After A comes G.
rows.translation: Vrstni red se ponavlja: C, A, G, E, D, nato spet C. Za A pride G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: With CAGED you rarely have to jump. Around fret 5, G is the D shape, C is the G shape and D is the A shape. Three chords, one spot.
rows.translation: S sistemom CAGED redko potrebuješ skok. Okoli prečke 5 je G prijem D, C prijem G, D pa prijem A. Trije akordi, eno mesto.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which shape plays C right beside the D-shape G?
rows.translation: S katerim prijemom igraš C tik ob G s prijemom D?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C's G shape uses frets 5 and 8, right where your hand already is.
rows.translation: Prijem G za akord C uporablja prečki 5 in 8, prav tam, kjer je že tvoja roka.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 7 (explain) · title

rows.source: The same idea works lower: G as the E shape at fret 3, C as the A shape at fret 3, and D as the C shape at fret 2.
rows.translation: Ista zamisel deluje nižje: G s prijemom E pri prečki 3, C s prijemom A pri prečki 3 in D s prijemom C pri prečki 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 7 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Lantern Hill is a Timbre Original: a campfire sing-along on G, C and D. Play its chorus open, then near fret 5, then near fret 3, and the same song moves around the neck. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Grič svetilk je izvirna pesem Timbre za skupno petje ob ognju na G, C in D. Refren igraj odprto, nato blizu prečke 5, nato blizu prečke 3 in ista pesem potuje po vratu. Celotna pesem je v razdelku Pesmi pod Izvirne pesmi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Near fret 5, which shape plays C?
rows.translation: S katerim prijemom igraš C blizu prečke 5?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C's G shape uses frets 5 and 8, right beside the D-shape G and the A-shape D.
rows.translation: Prijem G za C uporablja prečki 5 in 8, tik ob G s prijemom D in D s prijemom A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: No new ideas: G in all five shapes, and G, C and D near fret 3 and fret 5. Name each shape as you land it.
rows.translation: Brez novosti: G v vseh petih prijemih ter G, C in D blizu prečke 3 in prečke 5. Vsak prijem ob pristanku poimenuj.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · challenge gtr-17-6 “CAGED challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Three-note chords on the top strings: major and minor, every inversion, and progressions that barely move.
rows.translation: Tritonski akordi na zgornjih strunah: dur in mol, vsi obrati ter zaporedja s komaj opaznimi premiki.

rows.source: A triad is the smallest full chord: a root, a third and a fifth. On strings 3, 2 and 1, triads ring clear and bright, and they work anywhere on the neck.
rows.translation: Trozvok je najmanjši popolni akord: osnovni ton, terca in kvinta. Na strunah 3, 2 in 1 trozvoki zvenijo jasno in svetlo ter delujejo kjerkoli na vratu.

rows.source: Root, third, fifth: from C, skip a letter to E, then skip another to G.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton, terca, kvinta: od C preskoči črko do E, nato še eno do G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Move the lowest note to the top and you get an inversion. With E at the bottom, C sits at frets 9, 8 and 8. With G at the bottom, it's the top of your open C.
rows.translation: Najnižji ton prestavi na vrh in dobiš obrat. Z E spodaj je C pri prečkah 9, 8 in 8. Z G spodaj je to vrh tvojega odprtega C.

Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Every major triad on these strings uses one of three shapes, one per inversion. Learn them on G and D and you can find any major chord.
rows.translation: Vsak durov trozvok na teh strunah uporablja enega od treh prijemov, po enega na obrat. Nauči se jih na G in D in našel boš vsak durov akord.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G at frets 4, 3 and 3 has the same shape as…
rows.translation: G pri prečkah 4, 3 in 3 ima isti prijem kot…

Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Both put the third at the bottom: one fret up on string 3, the other two level. Same shape, five frets apart.
rows.translation: Oba imata terco spodaj: na struni 3 eno prečko višje, drugi dve sta poravnani. Isti prijem, pet prečk narazen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: D at frets 7, 7 and 5 has the root-position shape of your C at fret 5. Lower down, frets 2, 3 and 2 are the top of your open D.
rows.translation: D pri prečkah 7, 7 in 5 ima prijem osnovne lege tvojega C pri prečki 5. Nižje so prečke 2, 3 in 2 vrh tvojega odprtega D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A minor triad is a major triad with its third one fret lower. On these strings, A minor at frets 2, 1 and 0 is the top of your open A minor.
rows.translation: Molov trozvok je durov trozvok s terco eno prečko nižje. Na teh strunah je A-mol pri prečkah 2, 1 in 0 vrh tvojega odprtega A-mola.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Barre fret 5 across strings 3, 2 and 1 and you have A minor with C at the bottom. One finger, three notes.
rows.translation: Z barréjem pri prečki 5 čez strune 3, 2 in 1 dobiš A-mol s C spodaj. En prst, trije toni.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: E minor at frets 4, 5 and 3 puts B at the bottom. It sits right beside A minor at fret 5, so the change is tiny.
rows.translation: E-mol pri prečkah 4, 5 in 3 postavi B na dno. Leži tik ob A-molu pri prečki 5, zato je menjava drobna.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pick the inversion closest to your hand and a progression barely moves. G, E minor, C and D all live between frets 2 and 5.
rows.translation: Izberi obrat, ki je najbližje roki, in zaporedje se komaj premika. G, E-mol, C in D so vsi med prečkama 2 in 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: From G at frets 4, 3, 3 to E minor at 4, 5, 3, which notes stay?
rows.translation: Katera tona ostaneta pri prehodu iz G na prečkah 4, 3, 3 v E-mol na 4, 5, 3?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: B on string 3 and G on string 1 stay put. Only string 2 moves, from D up to E.
rows.translation: B na struni 3 in G na struni 1 ostaneta na mestu. Premakne se le struna 2, iz D navzgor v E.

rows.source: The same four chords sit higher too: G at frets 7, 8 and 7, E minor at 9, 8 and 7, C at 9, 8 and 8, and D at 7, 7 and 5.
rows.translation: Isti štirje akordi so tudi višje: G pri prečkah 7, 8 in 7, E-mol pri 9, 8 in 7, C pri 9, 8 in 8 ter D pri 7, 7 in 5.

rows.source: Play a triad's notes one at a time and you have an arpeggio. Through a progression, the notes make a melody of their own.
rows.translation: Tone trozvoka igraj posamično in dobiš arpeggio. Skozi zaporedje toni ustvarijo svojo melodijo.

rows.source: The top notes here run G, G, G, F sharp: almost still while the chords change under them. A note that two chords share is a common tone, and it's why triads sound so smooth.
rows.translation: Zgornji toni so tukaj G, G, G, F z višajem: skoraj mirujejo, medtem ko se akordi pod njimi menjajo. Ton, ki si ga delita dva akorda, je skupni ton; zato trozvoki zvenijo tako gladko.

rows.translation: Je šel zgornji ton navzgor ali navzdol?

rows.source: Roller Rink is a Timbre Original: retro dance pop on G, E minor, C and D, your four triads between frets 2 and 5. Small shapes on the top strings sound bright and tight, like a second guitar. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Kotalkališče je izvirna pesem Timbre: retro plesni pop na G, E-molu, C in D, tvojih štirih trozvokih med prečkama 2 in 5. Majhni prijemi na zgornjih strunah zvenijo svetlo in zgoščeno, kot druga kitara. Celotna pesem je v razdelku Pesmi pod Izvirne pesmi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Roller Rink's loop is the one, six, four and five of G. Which chord is the six?
rows.translation: Zanka pesmi Kotalkališče je ena, šest, štiri in pet v G. Kateri akord je šest?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up G major: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5, E 6. The chord on 6 is minor: E minor.
rows.translation: Štej navzgor po G-duru: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5, E 6. Akord na 6 je molov: E-mol.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Brez novosti: durovi in molovi trozvoki, njihovi obrati, G, E-mol, C in D na dveh mestih ter arpeggii. Vsak premik naj bo majhen.

rows.source: A major seventh chord adds the note one fret below the root's octave. It turns a plain major chord soft and dreamy. Open Cmaj7 is C with finger 1 lifted.
rows.translation: Veliki durov septakord doda ton eno prečko pod oktavo osnovnega tona. Navaden durov akord postane mehak in sanjav. Odprti Cmaj7 je C z dvignjenim prstom 1.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Cmaj7 is C plus which note?
rows.translation: Kateri ton dodamo C, da dobimo Cmaj7?

Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The major seventh sits one fret below the root's octave: B, just under C.
rows.translation: Velika septima je eno prečko pod oktavo osnovnega tona: B, tik pod C.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play the mini F, but let finger 1 press string 2 only. Open string 1, E, is the major seventh of F.
rows.translation: Zaigraj mali F, a naj prst 1 pritiska le struno 2. Prazna struna 1, E, je velika septima od F.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
