Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A minor seventh chord adds the note two frets below the root's octave. It sounds mellow, between dark and bright. Am7 is A minor with finger 3 lifted.
rows.translation: Mali molov septakord doda ton dve prečki pod oktavo osnovnega tona. Zveni mehko, med temnim in svetlim. Am7 je A-mol z dvignjenim prstom 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Dm7: finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, and finger 1 flat across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1. Em7: just finger 2 on string 5, fret 2.
rows.translation: Dm7: prst 2 na struni 3 pri prečki 2, prst 1 plosko čez struni 2 in 1 pri prečki 1. Em7: samo prst 2 na struni 5 pri prečki 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Am7 is A minor plus which note?
rows.translation: Kateri ton dodamo A-molu, da dobimo Am7?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The minor seventh sits two frets below the root's octave: G, two frets under A.
rows.translation: Mala septima je dve prečki pod oktavo osnovnega tona: G, dve prečki pod A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Sevenths with the root on string 5
rows.translation: Septakordi z osnovnim tonom na struni 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · title
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Finger 1 holds string 5 at fret 3 and lies across to string 1. Finger 3 takes string 4, finger 2 string 3 and finger 4 string 2.
rows.translation: Prst 1 drži struno 5 pri prečki 3 in leži čez strune do strune 1. Prst 3 prevzame struno 4, prst 2 struno 3, prst 4 pa struno 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Dm7 is your A minor barre with the little finger lifted. D7 is the A-shape barre with fingers 3 and 4 on strings 4 and 2. Both are named after string 5.
rows.translation: Dm7 je tvoj barré A-mola z dvignjenim mezincem. D7 je barré s prijemom A, s prstoma 3 in 4 na strunah 4 in 2. Oba imata ime po struni 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Dm7 at fret 5. Where is its root?
rows.translation: Dm7 pri prečki 5. Kje je njegov osnovni ton?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Like every A-shape chord, it's named after its note on string 5.
rows.translation: Kot vsak akord s prijemom A se imenuje po svojem tonu na struni 5.

Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Jazz's favorite move: the chord on the second note of the key, then the fifth, then home. In C that's Dm7, G7 and Cmaj7.
rows.translation: Najljubši jazzovski prehod: akord na drugem tonu tonalitete, nato na petem, nato domov. V C so to Dm7, G7 in Cmaj7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play the E7 shape as a barre at fret 3: finger 1 across all six strings, finger 3 on string 5 and finger 2 on string 3. Its root is on string 6.
rows.translation: Prijem E7 igraj kot barré pri prečki 3: prst 1 čez vseh šest strun, prst 3 na struno 5 in prst 2 na struno 3. Osnovni ton je na struni 6.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of C, which chord is the ii?
rows.translation: Kateri akord je ii v tonaliteti C?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from C: C is one, D is two. The seventh chord built on D is D minor seven.
rows.translation: Štej od C navzgor: C je ena, D je dve. Septakord, zgrajen na D, je mali molov septakord na D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 7 (explain) · title

rows.source: Jazz players often let each chord ring for just a moment. Squeeze as you strum, ease off right after, and the chords start to swing.
rows.translation: Jazz glasbeniki vsak akord pogosto pustijo zveneti le za hip. Ob potegu pritisni, takoj nato popusti in akordi začnejo swingati.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 7 (explain) · lesson card text

Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Swing guitarists comp: short chords that answer the band. The Charleston rhythm hits beat one and the swung and of two, then leaves space.
rows.translation: Swing kitaristi spremljajo s kratkimi akordi, ki odgovarjajo skupini. Ritem charleston udari na prvo dobo in na swingovski »in« po dve, nato pusti prostor.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: In G, the two, five, one is Am7, D7 and Gmaj7. Am7 is the E minor seven barre at fret 5; Gmaj7 skips string 5, with its root on string 6, fret 3.
rows.translation: V G so dve, pet, ena Am7, D7 in Gmaj7. Am7 je barré s prijemom malega molovega septakorda na E pri prečki 5; Gmaj7 izpusti struno 5, osnovni ton pa ima na struni 6 pri prečki 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Late Checkout is a Timbre Original: lo-fi in C on Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 and Am7. That's a ii–V–I, plus the six chord to start it over. Comp it with your barred sevenths and the Charleston. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Pozna odjava je izvirna pesem Timbre: lo-fi v C na Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 in Am7. To je ii–V–I z akordom šeste stopnje za nov začetek. Spremljaj jo z barré septakordi in charlestonom. Celotna pesem je v razdelku Pesmi pod Izvirne pesmi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In Late Checkout, which chord is the V?
rows.translation: Kateri akord je V v pesmi Pozna odjava?

rows.source: Count up C major: C 1, D 2, E 3, F 4, G 5. The seventh chord on G is G7.
rows.translation: Štej navzgor po C-duru: C 1, D 2, E 3, F 4, G 5. Septakord na G je G7.

rows.source: No new ideas: major, minor and dominant sevenths, open and barred, and the ii–V–I in C and G. Keep the chords short and the swing steady.

rows.source: G major in two octaves at fret 2, scale degrees and chords, and the Dorian and Mixolydian modes.

rows.source: A half step is one fret, a whole step two. Every major scale climbs whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half. That pattern gives major its sound.
rows.translation: Polton je ena prečka, cel ton pa dve. Vsaka durova lestvica se vzpenja: cel ton, cel ton, polton, cel ton, cel ton, cel ton, polton. Ta vzorec daje duru njegov zvok.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Put finger 1 at fret 2 and give each finger its own fret, up to fret 5. From G on string 6, fret 3, the scale climbs across strings 6, 5 and 4.
rows.translation: Prst 1 postavi pri prečki 2 in vsakemu prstu dodeli svojo prečko do prečke 5. Od G na struni 6 pri prečki 3 se lestvica vzpenja prek strun 6, 5 in 4.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 6: frets 3 and 5, fingers 2 and 4. String 5: frets 2 and 3, fingers 1 and 2.
rows.translation: Struna 6: prečki 3 in 5, prsta 2 in 4. Struna 5: prečki 2 in 3, prsta 1 in 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: String 5, fret 5, then string 4: frets 2, 4 and 5. Home on G.
rows.translation: Struna 5, prečka 5, nato struna 4: prečke 2, 4 in 5. Domov na G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where do the half steps fall in a major scale?
rows.translation: Kje sta poltona v durovi lestvici?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Whole, whole, half: the first half step is from 3 to 4. Whole, whole, whole, half: the second is from 7 to 8.
rows.translation: Cel ton, cel ton, polton: prvi polton je od 3 do 4. Cel ton, cel ton, cel ton, polton: drugi je od 7 do 8.

rows.source: The same position carries on: A, B and C on string 3, D and E on string 2, F sharp and G on string 1. Your hand never moves.
rows.translation: Ista lega se nadaljuje: A, B in C na struni 3, D in E na struni 2, F z višajem in G na struni 1. Roka se ne premakne.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3: frets 2, 4, 5. String 2: frets 3, 5. String 1: frets 2, 3.
rows.translation: Struna 3: prečke 2, 4, 5. Struna 2: prečki 3, 5. Struna 1: prečki 2, 3.

rows.source: In this position, which finger plays fret 5?
rows.translation: Kateri prst v tej legi igra pri prečki 5?

rows.source: Finger 1 sits at fret 2, so fret 5 belongs to finger 4, your little finger.
rows.translation: Prst 1 je pri prečki 2, zato prečka 5 pripada prstu 4, mezincu.

rows.translation: Dve oktavi, od G do G

rows.translation: Joy to the World v priredbi Lowella Masona iz leta 1839 se začne s spustom po G-durovi lestvici od vrha. Vse tone že poznaš.

rows.source: Number the scale from G: G is 1, A is 2, and so on up to F sharp, 7. Musicians use these numbers to talk about melodies and chords in any key.
rows.translation: Lestvico oštevilči od G: G je 1, A je 2 in tako naprej do F z višajem, 7. Glasbeniki s temi številkami govorijo o melodijah in akordih v katerikoli tonaliteti.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In G major, which note is 5?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from G: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5.
rows.translation: Štej od G navzgor: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Stack every other scale note on each degree and you get the key's chords. Chords on 1, 4 and 5 are major; on 2, 3 and 6 they're minor. In G: G, C and D, then A minor, B minor and E minor.
rows.translation: Na vsaki stopnji zloži vsak drugi ton lestvice in dobiš akorde tonalitete. Akordi na 1, 4 in 5 so durovi, na 2, 3 in 6 pa molovi. V G: G, C in D ter A-mol, B-mol in E-mol.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In G major, which chord is built on 6?
rows.translation: Kateri akord je v G-duru zgrajen na 6?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The sixth note is E, and chords on 2, 3 and 6 are minor. Stack E, G and B: E minor.
rows.translation: Šesti ton je E, akordi na 2, 3 in 6 pa so molovi. Zloži E, G in B: E-mol.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play G major's notes but treat A as home, and the scale turns minor. This sound is A Dorian, a mode of G major: same position, new starting note.
rows.translation: Igraj tone G-dura, a naj bo A domači ton, in lestvica dobi molov značaj. To je dorski modus na A, modus G-dura: ista lega, nov začetni ton.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Start on A, string 6, fret 5, with finger 4, and climb the same frets to A on string 3.
rows.translation: Začni na A, struna 6, prečka 5, s prstom 4 in se po istih prečkah vzpni do A na struni 3.

rows.source: Which note makes A Dorian brighter than plain A minor?
rows.translation: Kateri ton naredi dorski modus na A svetlejši od naravnega A-mola?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Plain A minor has F. Dorian keeps G major's F sharp: a bright spot in a minor scale.
rows.translation: Naravni A-mol ima F. Dorski modus ohrani F z višajem iz G-dura: svetlo točko v molovi lestvici.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Melodija v dorskem modusu na A

Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now treat D as home. G major's notes from D to D make D Mixolydian: a major scale with its seventh one fret lower. It's all over folk, rock and fiddle tunes.
rows.translation: Zdaj naj bo D domači ton. Toni G-dura od D do D dajo miksolidijski modus na D: durovo lestvico s septimo eno prečko nižje. Pogost je v folku, rocku in ljudskih violinskih melodijah.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: From D on string 5, fret 5, up the same position to D on string 2, fret 3.
rows.translation: Od D na struni 5 pri prečki 5 po isti legi navzgor do D na struni 2 pri prečki 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: D major has C sharp. D Mixolydian has…
rows.translation: D-dur ima C z višajem. Miksolidijski modus na D ima…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Mixolydian lowers the seventh by one fret, so G major's C becomes its flavor note.
rows.translation: Miksolidijski modus zniža septimo za eno prečko, zato C iz G-dura postane njegov značilni ton.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Melodija v miksolidijskem modusu na D
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 5 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Any note of the major scale can be home. From G it's major, from A Dorian, from D Mixolydian, from E plain minor. Same frets, different moods.
rows.translation: Vsak ton durove lestvice je lahko dom. Od G je dur, od A dorski modus, od D miksolidijski, od E naravni mol. Iste prečke, različna razpoloženja.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Market Day is a Timbre Original: sunny pop in G with a highlife bounce, the bright guitar music of West Africa. Its hook uses only G major's notes, so it sits inside your second-position scale. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Tržni dan je izvirna pesem Timbre: sončen pop v G z zibanjem highlifa, svetle kitarske glasbe Zahodne Afrike. Značilni motiv uporablja le tone G-dura, zato leži v tvoji lestvici v drugi legi. Celotna pesem je v razdelku Pesmi pod Izvirne pesmi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Market Day's chords are G, B minor, C and D. Which scale degrees are they on?
rows.translation: Akordi pesmi Tržni dan so G, B-mol, C in D. Na katerih lestvičnih stopnjah so?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: G is 1, B is 3, C is 4 and D is 5. The chord on 3 is minor in every major key: B minor.
rows.translation: G je 1, B je 3, C je 4 in D je 5. Akord na 3 je v vsaki durovi tonaliteti molov: B-mol.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, B at fret 4 on string 3, D again, E at fret 5 with finger 4, then D and B.
rows.translation: D pri prečki 3 na struni 2, B pri prečki 4 na struni 3, spet D, E pri prečki 5 s prstom 4, nato D in B.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: No new ideas: G major in two octaves, the scale in thirds, A Dorian and D Mixolydian. Keep one finger per fret.
rows.translation: Brez novosti: G-dur v dveh oktavah, lestvica v tercah, dorski modus na A in miksolidijski na D. Ohrani en prst na prečko.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · challenge gtr-20-6 “Scale challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half spells…
rows.translation: Katera lestvica ima zaporedje cel ton, cel ton, polton, cel ton, cel ton, cel ton, polton?

rows.translation: Kateri modus se začne na drugem tonu G-dura?

rows.source: The major pentatonic, country hammer-ons and slides, trills, phrasing, and sweet and sour over the blues.
rows.translation: Durova pentatonika, country hammer-oni in slidi, trilčki, fraziranje ter sladko in trpko v bluesu.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 “Major pentatonic and expressive lead” · unit summary
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · title
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Move your minor pentatonic box from fret 5 down to fret 2 and treat A as home: it turns sweet and major. That's A major pentatonic: A, B, C sharp, E and F sharp.
rows.translation: Molov pentatonični vzorec prestavi s prečke 5 na prečko 2 in naj bo A domači ton: zvok postane sladek in durov. To je A-durova pentatonika: A, B, C z višajem, E in F z višajem.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: From A on string 6, fret 5, then frets 2 and 4 on strings 5 and 4, and A at fret 2 on string 3.
rows.translation: Od A na struni 6 pri prečki 5, nato prečki 2 in 4 na strunah 5 in 4 ter A pri prečki 2 na struni 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which notes are in A major pentatonic?
rows.translation: Kateri toni so v A-durovi pentatoniki?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A, B, C sharp, E, F sharp
rows.translation: A, B, C z višajem, E, F z višajem
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Five notes of the A major scale, its two half steps left out. The minor box at fret 5 holds A, C, D, E and G.
rows.translation: Pet tonov A-durove lestvice, brez njenih dveh poltonov. Molov vzorec pri prečki 5 vsebuje A, C, D, E in G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A major pentatonic, up and down
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 4 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: This box at fret 2 is also F sharp minor pentatonic, from its F sharp. The note you treat as home decides which one you're playing.
rows.translation: Ta vzorec pri prečki 2 je tudi molova pentatonika na F z višajem, če začneš na F z višajem. Domači ton določi, katero igraš.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 6 (along) · title

Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Country players love hammer-ons inside this box: E to F sharp on string 4, A to B on string 3. Pick the first note, then hammer the second.
rows.translation: Country glasbeniki radi uporabljajo hammer-one v tem vzorcu: iz E v F z višajem na struni 4, iz A v B na struni 3. Uberi prvi ton, drugi pa naj zazveni s hammer-onom.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 4: pick fret 2, then hammer finger 3 onto fret 4.
rows.translation: Struna 4: uberi pri prečki 2, nato s prstom 3 udari na prečko 4.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.translation: S slidom navzgor do C z višajem
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now slide finger 3 on string 3 from fret 4 to fret 6, B up to C sharp, then glide back into the box.
rows.translation: Zdaj s prstom 3 zdrsni po struni 3 od prečke 4 do prečke 6, iz B navzgor v C z višajem, nato zdrsni nazaj v vzorec.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Finger 3 on string 3, fret 4. Pick, then slide to fret 6 without lifting.
rows.translation: Prst 3 na struni 3 pri prečki 4. Uberi, nato brez dviga zdrsni do prečke 6.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A trill flutters between two notes: one pick, then hammer-on, pull-off, over and over. Keep it even before you make it fast.
rows.translation: Trilček trepeta med dvema tonoma: en brenk, nato hammer-on, pull-off, znova in znova. Najprej naj bo enakomeren, šele nato hiter.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3: frets 2 and 4. Pick once, then hammer and pull with finger 3.
rows.translation: Struna 3: prečki 2 in 4. Uberi enkrat, nato s prstom 3 izmenjuj hammer-on in pull-off.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Start one fret below the note you want and slide up into it as you pick. The target is what counts: land it right on the beat.
rows.translation: Začni eno prečko pod želenim tonom in ob ubiranju zdrsni navzgor vanj. Šteje cilj: pristani točno na dobo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: When you slide into a note, which one lands on the beat?
rows.translation: Ko zdrsneš v ton, kateri pristane na dobo?

rows.source: The slide starts just before the beat, so the note you're aiming for arrives right on it.
rows.translation: Slide se začne tik pred dobo, da ciljni ton prispe točno nanjo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: V vsako frazo vstopi s slidom

rows.source: Over a blues in A, both boxes work. Major pentatonic at fret 2 sounds sweet; minor at fret 5 sounds tough. Good players move between them.
rows.translation: Ob bluesu v A delujeta oba vzorca. Durova pentatonika pri prečki 2 zveni sladko, molova pri prečki 5 pa trdo. Dobri glasbeniki prehajajo med njima.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 2 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Which box sounds sweeter over A7?
rows.translation: Kateri vzorec ob A7 zveni slajše?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The major pentatonic holds C sharp, the third of A7. The minor box's C rubs against it, and that rub is the blues.
rows.translation: Durova pentatonika vsebuje C z višajem, terco A7. C iz molovega vzorca se tare obnjo in to trenje je blues.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Ask a tough question at fret 5, then answer it sweetly at fret 2. Shift your hand on the long note, and land both phrases on A.
rows.translation: Pri prečki 5 postavi trdo vprašanje, nato pri prečki 2 sladko odgovori. Roko premakni med dolgim tonom in obe frazi končaj na A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Great solos breathe. Play a short phrase, rest about as long as it lasted, then answer. The silence makes the next notes count.
rows.translation: Odlični soli dihajo. Zaigraj kratko frazo, počivaj približno toliko časa, kot je trajala, nato odgovori. Tišina da naslednjim tonom težo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: After a two-beat phrase, how long might you rest?
rows.translation: Kako dolgo bi lahko počival po dvodobni frazi?

rows.source: Play a phrase twice the same way, then change only its ending. Listeners hear the repeat and lean in for the twist.
rows.translation: Frazo dvakrat zaigraj enako, nato spremeni le konec. Poslušalci slišijo ponovitev in prisluhnejo preobratu.

rows.source: Hold each long note and rock it with a small, even push and release. Keep it narrow: the pitch should waver, never wander off.
rows.translation: Vsak dolgi ton zadrži in ga zazibaj z majhnim, enakomernim potiskom in popustitvijo. Naj bo ozko: višina naj valuje, ne odplava.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Slow Motion Strobe is a Timbre Original: synth-pop in A on F sharp minor, D, A and E. Your box at fret 2 fits the whole loop: A major pentatonic, which is F sharp minor pentatonic too. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Stroboskop v počasnem posnetku je izvirna pesem Timbre: synth-pop v A na molu na F z višajem, D, A in E. Vzorec pri prečki 2 ustreza celi zanki: A-durova pentatonika, ki je tudi molova pentatonika na F z višajem. Celotna pesem je v razdelku Pesmi pod Izvirne pesmi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Listen to the first chord. Major or minor?
rows.translation: Poslušaj prvi akord. Dur ali mol?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Over F sharp minor and D
rows.translation: Ob molu na F z višajem in D

Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: Which box notes belong to the E chord?
rows.translation: Katera tona vzorca pripadata akordu E?

Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: C z višajem in F z višajem

Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: E is E, G sharp and B. The box holds E and B but no G sharp, so lean on those two over E.
rows.translation: E sestavljajo E, G z višajem in B. Vzorec vsebuje E in B, ne pa G z višajem, zato se ob E opri na ta dva tona.

rows.translation: Brez novosti: durova pentatonika, hammer-oni, slidi, trilčki in oba vzorca ob bluesu. Pusti prostor in končaj na A.

rows.source: Slide the minor box from fret 5 to fret 2 and it plays…
rows.translation: Molov vzorec podrsaj s prečke 5 na prečko 2. Katero lestvico dobiš?

rows.source: Verse, chorus and AABA, intros and tags, texture and fills, and your own arrangement of Down by the Riverside.
rows.translation: Kitica, refren in AABA, uvodi in dodatki, zvočna tekstura, vmesne fraze in tvoja priredba Down by the Riverside.

rows.source: Most songs are built from a few sections: verses that tell the story, a chorus that repeats the hook, and sometimes a bridge for contrast. Knowing the plan keeps you from getting lost.
rows.translation: Večino pesmi sestavlja nekaj delov: kitice, ki pripovedujejo zgodbo, refren, ki ponavlja značilni motiv, in včasih most za kontrast. Če poznaš načrt, se ne izgubiš.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What does a chorus usually carry?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Značilni motiv, ki ga vsi pojejo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The chorus returns with the same words and tune. It's the part people remember and sing along to.
rows.translation: Refren se vrne z istim besedilom in melodijo. To je del, ki si ga ljudje zapomnijo in pojejo zraven.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Many older songs use AABA: a tune, the same tune again, a contrasting bridge, then the tune once more. Each section often runs eight bars; here they run four.
rows.translation: Veliko starejših pesmi uporablja AABA: melodija, ista melodija znova, kontrastni most in še enkrat melodija. Vsak del pogosto traja osem taktov; tukaj trajajo štiri.

rows.source: Jukebox Moon is a Timbre Original: a fifties slow dance in AABA form, a verse, the verse again, a bridge on F, then the verse once more. Strum every beat, with a quick swung up into each new bar. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Luna iz džuboksa je izvirna pesem Timbre: počasen ples iz petdesetih v obliki AABA, kitica, znova kitica, most na F in še enkrat kitica. Potegni na vsako dobo, s hitrim swingovskim potegom navzgor pred novim taktom. Celotna pesem je v razdelku Pesmi pod Izvirne pesmi.

rows.source: On most instruments the strings get lower as you go up. On ukulele, string 4 (G) is higher than string 3 (C). This is called re-entrant tuning.
rows.translation: Pri večini glasbil so strune nižje, ko greš navzgor. Pri ukulele je struna 4 (G) višja od strune 3 (C). Temu pravimo povratna uglasitev.

rows.source: Your second finger sits on fret 2 of string 4 for both. Keep it down when you change.
rows.translation: Pri obeh je drugi prst pri prečki 2 na struni 4. Med menjavo ga pusti na mestu.

rows.source: G7, the chord that leads home

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second on fret 2 of string 3, third on fret 2 of string 1. Strum all four.
rows.translation: Prvi prst pri prečki 1 na struni 2, drugi pri prečki 2 na struni 3, tretji pri prečki 2 na struni 1. Potegni po vseh štirih.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G7 sounds unfinished. Play C after it and the tension lets go. That pull is why so many songs put G7 before C.
rows.translation: G7 zveni nedokončano. Za njim zaigraj C in napetost popusti. Zaradi tega vleka toliko pesmi postavi G7 pred C.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Does this end at home or leave you hanging?
rows.translation: Se to konča doma ali pusti pričakovanje?

rows.source: First finger on fret 2 of string 3, second on fret 2 of string 1, third on fret 3 of string 2. Arch your fingers so string 4 rings.
rows.translation: Prvi prst pri prečki 2 na struni 3, drugi pri prečki 2 na struni 1, tretji pri prečki 3 na struni 2. Prste ukrivi, da struna 4 zveni.

rows.source: G and G7 both press which spot?

rows.source: Both chords put a finger on fret 2 of string 3. Use it as your anchor.
rows.translation: Oba akorda imata prst pri prečki 2 na struni 3. Uporabi ga kot oporo.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-5 “G: three fingers” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: C, A minor, F, G7 and G cover hundreds of songs. Make each shape clean, then keep the beat as you change.
rows.translation: C, A-mol, F, G7 in G pokrijejo stotine pesmi. Vsak prijem naj bo čist, nato med menjavami ohrani ritem.

rows.translation: Enakomerni potegi navzdol, dol-gor in otoški vzorec.

rows.source: Strum down on every beat: 1, 2, 3, 4. Use the nail of your index finger. When you change chords, your hand keeps moving.
rows.translation: Na vsako dobo potegni navzdol: 1, 2, 3, 4. Uporabi noht kazalca. Med menjavo akordov se roka še naprej giblje.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-1 “Steady down strums” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Kaj naj roka počne med menjavo akordov?

rows.source: A late chord is better than a broken beat. Keep strumming, even if a string buzzes.
rows.translation: Pozen akord je boljši kot prekinjen ritem. Poteguj naprej, tudi če struna brenči.

rows.source: Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Strum down on the numbers, up on each and. Your hand never stops moving.
rows.translation: Štej 1 in 2 in 3 in 4 in. Na številke potegni navzdol, na vsak »in« navzgor. Roka se nikoli ne ustavi.

rows.source: Up strums mostly catch strings 1 and 2. Brush them with the pad of your finger, a little softer than the downs.
rows.translation: Potegi navzgor večinoma ujamejo struni 1 in 2. Z blazinico prsta potegni po njiju malo nežneje kot navzdol.

rows.source: Down on 1, down-up on 2, down on 3, down-up on 4. Your hand still swings up after 1 and 3; it just misses the strings.
rows.translation: Dol na 1, dol-gor na 2, dol na 3, dol-gor na 4. Roka po 1 in 3 še vedno zaniha navzgor, le strun se ne dotakne.

rows.translation: Tihi zamah navzgor ohrani roko v ritmu za naslednji poteg navzdol.

rows.source: Down on 1, down-up on 2, skip the down on 3, then up, down-up. The missing down gives it a lilt.
rows.translation: Dol na 1, dol-gor na 2, izpusti dol na 3, nato gor, dol-gor. Manjkajoči poteg navzdol da vzorcu zibanje.

rows.translation: Kateri poteg izpustiš v otoškem vzorcu?

rows.source: Your hand still moves down on 3, it just misses the strings. That keeps the up after it in time.
rows.translation: Roka se na 3 še vedno premakne navzdol, le strune zgreši. Tako naslednji poteg navzgor ostane v ritmu.

rows.translation: Zadnji poteg navzgor v taktu je lahko sproščen ali po praznih strunah. Izkoristi ga za premik v naslednji akord, da doba 1 zazveni čisto.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-5 “Island strum with changes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

Ukulele · Unit 3 · challenge uke-3-6 “Challenge: strum patterns” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Downs, down-ups and the island strum. Keep your hand moving and let the chords come to you.
rows.translation: Potegi navzdol, dol-gor in otoški vzorec. Roka naj se giblje, akordi pa naj pridejo k tebi.

rows.source: C D E F G A B C. Start on open string 3 and climb across strings 2 and 1. Every note sits in the first three frets.
rows.translation: C D E F G A B C. Začni na prazni struni 3 in se vzpenjaj prek strun 2 in 1. Vsi toni so pri prvih treh prečkah.

rows.translation: Struna 3 prazna in pri prečki 2, nato struna 2 prazna in pri prečki 1.

rows.source: String 2 fret 3, then string 1: open, fret 2, fret 3.
rows.translation: Struna 2, prečka 3, nato struna 1: prazna, prečka 2, prečka 3.

Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-5 “Four chords, endless songs” · title

rows.source: Number the notes of the C scale and you can name chords by number: C is I, G is V, A minor is vi, F is IV. This order runs through countless songs.
rows.translation: Oštevilči tone C-durove lestvice in akorde lahko imenuješ po številkah: C je I, G je V, A-mol je vi, F je IV. To zaporedje najdeš v neštetih pesmih.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-5 “Four chords, endless songs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of C, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Kateri akord je IV v tonaliteti C?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-5 “Four chords, endless songs” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up the scale from C: C, D, E, F. F is the fourth note, so F is the IV chord.
rows.translation: Štej po lestvici od C: C, D, E, F. F je četrti ton, zato je F akord IV.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-5 “Four chords, endless songs” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Which chord is vi in C?
rows.translation: Kateri akord je vi v C?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-5 “Four chords, endless songs” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Lowercase numbers mean minor chords. The sixth note of C major is A.
rows.translation: Rimske številke z malimi črkami pomenijo molove akorde. Šesti ton C-dura je A.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-5 “Four chords, endless songs” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 5 · challenge uke-5-6 “Challenge: ten chords” · title
Ukulele · Unit 5 · challenge uke-5-6 “Challenge: ten chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: C, A minor, F, G, G7, D minor, E minor, D, A and E7. Clean shapes first, then steady strums.
rows.translation: C, A-mol, F, G, G7, D-mol, E-mol, D, A in E7. Najprej čisti prijemi, nato enakomerni potegi.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · challenge uke-5-6 “Challenge: ten chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of C, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Kateri akord je V v tonaliteti C?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · challenge uke-5-6 “Challenge: ten chords” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 6 “Songs” · title

rows.source: Four public-domain songs with melody and chords.
rows.translation: Štiri pesmi v javni domeni z melodijo in akordi.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 “Songs” · unit summary
Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-1 “Oh! Susanna” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Stephen Foster wrote this song in 1848. It counts in two: 1 and 2 and. Most notes are quick eighth notes.
rows.translation: Stephen Foster je to pesem napisal leta 1848. Štejemo v dvoje: 1 in 2 in. Večina not so hitre osminke.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-1 “Oh! Susanna” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The opening: C D E G, G A G E.
rows.translation: Začetek: C D E G, G A G E.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-1 “Oh! Susanna” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-1 “Oh! Susanna” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Another Foster song, from 1850. The melody bounces between G and E, and a short two-note call answers each line.
rows.translation: Še ena Fosterjeva pesem, iz leta 1850. Melodija poskakuje med G in E, kratek dvotonski klic pa odgovarja na vsako vrstico.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-2 “Camptown Races” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-2 “Camptown Races” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Like most songs in C, it comes home to C.
rows.translation: Kot večina pesmi v C se vrne domov na C.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-2 “Camptown Races” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Count 1 2 3, 1 2 3, with the weight on 1. This is waltz time. "Clementine", first printed in 1884, sways in three.
rows.translation: Štej 1 2 3, 1 2 3 s poudarkom na 1. To je valčkov takt. »Clementine«, prvič natisnjena leta 1884, se ziblje v troje.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-3 “Clementine” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 2 fret 1, open 3, open 1, then string 1 frets 3 and 1.
rows.translation: Struna 2, prečka 1, prazna 3, prazna 1, nato struna 1 pri prečkah 3 in 1.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-3 “Clementine” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-3 “Clementine” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 1. With F, it carries the whole song.
rows.translation: Prvi prst pri prečki 1 na struni 1. Skupaj s F nosi celo pesem.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-3 “Clementine” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This traditional tune was in print by 1896. Each line ends on a long note, so count it out before the next one.
rows.translation: Ta tradicionalna melodija je bila natisnjena najpozneje leta 1896. Vsaka vrstica se konča z dolgim tonom; odštej ga do konca pred naslednjim.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open 3, string 2 fret 1, open 1, string 2 fret 3, string 1 frets 1 and 3.
rows.translation: Prazna 3, struna 2 pri prečki 1, prazna 1, struna 2 pri prečki 3, struna 1 pri prečkah 1 in 3.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The last line starts D, C sharp, C. How do those notes move?
rows.translation: Zadnja vrstica se začne D, C z višajem, C. Kako se ti toni premikajo?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Down one fret at a time
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Each note is one fret lower on string 3: fret 2, fret 1, open.
rows.translation: Vsak ton je eno prečko nižje na struni 3: prečka 2, prečka 1, prazna.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Ukulele · Unit 6 · lesson uke-6-5 “Back a song with chords” · title
Ukulele · Unit 6 · lesson uke-6-5 “Back a song with chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: When you strum a song, the melody lives in your head or in a friend's voice. Change chords where the tune leans, and keep the strum steady.
rows.translation: Ko pesem igraš s potegi, melodija živi v tvoji glavi ali prijateljevem glasu. Akorde menjaj tam, kjer se melodija nagne, potegi pa naj bodo enakomerni.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · lesson uke-6-5 “Back a song with chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A song in F usually ends on which chord?
rows.translation: Na katerem akordu se običajno konča pesem v F?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · lesson uke-6-5 “Back a song with chords” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Songs come home to their key chord. In F, that's F.
rows.translation: Pesmi se vrnejo domov k akordu svoje tonalitete. V F je to F.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · lesson uke-6-5 “Back a song with chords” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 6 · challenge uke-6-6 “Challenge: your first set” · title
Ukulele · Unit 6 · challenge uke-6-6 “Challenge: your first set” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Four songs, a handful of chords and three strums. Play them like a small concert: count in, keep going, finish strong.
rows.translation: Štiri pesmi, peščica akordov in trije vzorci potegov. Igraj jih kot majhen koncert: odštej začetek, nadaljuj in odločno končaj.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · challenge uke-6-6 “Challenge: your first set” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 7 “New keys” · title

rows.source: B flat, D7, B minor and G minor, the keys of G, F and D, and moving a song to any key.
rows.translation: B z nižajem, D7, B-mol in G-mol, tonalitete G, F in D ter prenos pesmi v katerokoli tonaliteto.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 “New keys” · unit summary
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-1 “B flat: a small barre” · title
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-1 “B flat: a small barre” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1. Finger 2 goes on string 3, fret 2, and finger 3 on string 4, fret 3.
rows.translation: Prst 1 položi čez struni 2 in 1 pri prečki 1. Prst 2 gre na struno 3 pri prečki 2, prst 3 pa na struno 4 pri prečki 3.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-1 “B flat: a small barre” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord shares finger 1's spot on string 2 with B flat?
rows.translation: Kateri akord ima prst 1 na struni 2 na istem mestu kot B z nižajem?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-1 “B flat: a small barre” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F also puts finger 1 on string 2, fret 1. Keep it there as you change.
rows.translation: Tudi F postavi prst 1 na struno 2 pri prečki 1. Med menjavo ga pusti tam.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-1 “B flat: a small barre” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: D7 and the key of G
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · title

rows.source: D7: a barre and one finger
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 2, and put finger 2 on string 1, fret 3.
rows.translation: Prst 1 položi čez strune 4, 3 in 2 pri prečki 2, prst 2 pa na struno 1 pri prečki 3.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: In G, the chords G, C and D7 do most of the work, with E minor for a darker color. D7 pulls back to G the way G7 pulls to C.
rows.translation: V G večino dela opravijo G, C in D7, E-mol pa doda temnejšo barvo. D7 vleče nazaj v G, kot G7 vleče v C.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: B minor and the key of D
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · title
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 2, then reach finger 3 to string 4, fret 4.
rows.translation: Prst 1 položi čez strune 3, 2 in 1 pri prečki 2, nato s prstom 3 sezi do strune 4 pri prečki 4.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D and B minor both press fret 2 on which strings?
rows.translation: Na katerih strunah D in B-mol oba pritiskata pri prečki 2?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Both chords hold fret 2 on strings 3 and 2. Only the outer strings change.
rows.translation: Oba akorda držita prečko 2 na strunah 3 in 2. Spremenita se le zunanji struni.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: In D, the chords D, G and A7 carry the song, and B minor adds a sad one. A7 is a single finger: string 3, fret 1.
rows.translation: V D pesem nosijo akordi D, G in A7, B-mol pa doda žalosten akord. A7 potrebuje en prst: struna 3, prečka 1.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · title
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A song's chords are steps of its key: I, IV and V. Change key and the numbers stay. In C that's C, F and G7; in G, it's G, C and D7; in F, F, B flat and C7.
rows.translation: Akordi pesmi so stopnje njene tonalitete: I, IV in V. Zamenjaj tonaliteto in številke ostanejo. V C so to C, F in G7; v G so G, C in D7; v F pa F, B z nižajem in C7.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of F, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Kateri akord je IV v tonaliteti F?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from F: F, G, A, B flat. The fourth note is B flat.
rows.translation: Štej od F navzgor: F, G, A, B z nižajem. Četrti ton je B z nižajem.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: If a song sits too high or too low to sing, move it to another key. Same numbers, same song, just a better fit for the voice.
rows.translation: Če je pesem za petje previsoka ali prenizka, jo prestavi v drugo tonaliteto. Iste številke, ista pesem, le bolje prilagojena glasu.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of D, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Kateri akord je V v tonaliteti D?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from D: D, E, F sharp, G, A. A is the fifth note, so A7 is the V chord.
rows.translation: Štej od D navzgor: D, E, F z višajem, G, A. A je peti ton, zato je A7 akord V.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · title
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, finger 3 on string 2, fret 3, and finger 1 on string 1, fret 1. String 4 rings open.
rows.translation: Prst 2 na struno 3 pri prečki 2, prst 3 na struno 2 pri prečki 3, prst 1 pa na struno 1 pri prečki 1. Struna 4 zveni prazna.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: D minor's family is D minor, G minor and A7. A7 pulls home to D minor, the way E7 pulls to A minor.
rows.translation: Družino D-mola sestavljajo D-mol, G-mol in A7. A7 vleče domov v D-mol, kot E7 vleče v A-mol.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · title
Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: B flat, D7, B minor and G minor, and the keys of C, G, F and D. Clean shapes first, then a steady strum.
rows.translation: Brez novosti: B z nižajem, D7, B-mol in G-mol ter tonalitete C, G, F in D. Najprej čisti prijemi, nato enakomeren poteg.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of G, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Kateri akord je V v tonaliteti G?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 8 “Strum styles” · title

rows.source: The chunk, the island strum with a backbeat, swing and the ragtime chords, accents in 3-3-2, and the waltz.
rows.translation: Dušeni udarec, otoški vzorec s poudarkom na šibkih dobah, swing in ragtime akordi, poudarki 3-3-2 ter valček.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 “Strum styles” · unit summary
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · title
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A chunk is a strum that stops dead. Strum down and let the side of your palm land on the strings at the same moment: a short, dry click, like a snare drum.
rows.translation: Dušeni udarec je poteg, ki se takoj ustavi. Potegni navzdol in hkrati nasloni rob dlani na strune: kratek, suh klik, kot mali boben.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Strum down on 1, chunk on 2, down-up on 3, chunk on 4. The chunks fall where a drummer hits the snare.
rows.translation: Potegni navzdol na 1, dušeno udari na 2, dol-gor na 3 in dušeno na 4. Dušeni udarci padejo tja, kjer bobnar udari mali boben.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Two and four are the backbeat, where the snare drum plays. A chunk there gives the strum a drummer's punch.
rows.translation: Dve in štiri sta poudarjeni šibki dobi, kjer igra mali boben. Dušeni udarec tam da potegom bobnarsko udarnost.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · title

rows.source: Swap one down for a chunk
rows.translation: En poteg navzdol zamenjaj z dušenim
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Take the island strum, D, DU, UDU, and turn the down on 2 into a chunk. The rhythm stays the same; the groove gets a backbeat.
rows.translation: Vzemi otoški vzorec D, DU, UDU in poteg navzdol na 2 spremeni v dušeni udarec. Ritem ostane isti, dobi pa poudarek na šibki dobi.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In this strum, which stroke becomes the chunk?
rows.translation: Kateri poteg v tem vzorcu postane dušeni udarec?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Beat 1 rings out, beat 2 clicks. Everything else stays where the island strum had it.
rows.translation: Doba 1 zveni, doba 2 klikne. Vse drugo ostane tam, kjer je bilo v otoškem vzorcu.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · title

rows.source: Swing splits each beat unevenly: a long down, then a short up. Say hum-pty, dum-pty as you strum. It's the bounce of old ukulele tunes.
rows.translation: Swing vsako dobo razdeli neenakomerno: dolg poteg navzdol, nato kratek navzgor. Med potegi izgovarjaj dum-da, dum-da. To je zibanje starih melodij za ukulele.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: C, A7, D7, G7, then home to C. Each seventh chord pulls to the next, a little chain of tension. It powered countless songs a century ago.
rows.translation: C, A7, D7, G7, nato domov v C. Vsak septakord vleče k naslednjemu, majhna veriga napetosti. Pred stoletjem je poganjala nešteto pesmi.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord does D7 pull toward here?
rows.translation: Proti kateremu akordu tukaj vleče D7?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D7 leads to G, and G7 leads home to C. Each chord sets up the next.
rows.translation: D7 vodi v G, G7 pa domov v C. Vsak akord pripravi naslednjega.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · title
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Strum steady down-up eighths, but hit three of them harder: 1, the and of 2, and 4. The accents fall 3, 3 and 2 eighths apart.
rows.translation: Igraj enakomerne osminke dol-gor, a tri udari močneje: 1, »in« po 2 in 4. Med poudarki je 3, 3 in 2 osminki.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Count 1 2 3, 1 2 3, 1 2 across the bar's eight eighths. Each 1 is an accent.
rows.translation: Čez osem osmink takta štej 1 2 3, 1 2 3, 1 2. Vsaka 1 je poudarek.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: George Formby's split stroke on the banjo ukulele puts its big strums in the same three places, with single strings in between. Master the accents first.
rows.translation: Deljeni poteg Georgea Formbyja na banjo ukulele postavi močne potege na ista tri mesta, vmes pa posamezne strune. Najprej osvoji poudarke.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · title
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In three, strum down on 1, then down-up on 2 and on 3: D, DU, DU. Lean on 1 so the sway is clear.
rows.translation: V tridobnem taktu potegni dol na 1, nato dol-gor na 2 in na 3: D, DU, DU. Poudari 1, da bo zibanje jasno.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many strums fill this bar of three?
rows.translation: Koliko potegov zapolni ta tridobni takt?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Down on 1, then down-up on 2 and on 3: one plus two plus two.
rows.translation: Dol na 1, nato dol-gor na 2 in na 3: ena plus dve plus dve.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · challenge uke-8-6 “Challenge: strum styles” · title
Ukulele · Unit 8 · challenge uke-8-6 “Challenge: strum styles” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: chunks, the island strum with a chunk, swing, the 3-3-2 accents and the waltz. Keep the hand moving and let the accents speak.
rows.translation: Brez novosti: dušeni udarci, otoški vzorec z dušenim udarcem, swing, poudarki 3-3-2 in valček. Roka naj se giblje in poudarki naj govorijo.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · challenge uke-8-6 “Challenge: strum styles” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In a swing strum, each beat splits into…
rows.translation: Pri swingovskem potegu se vsaka doba razdeli na…
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · challenge uke-8-6 “Challenge: strum styles” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Ubiranje s prsti in akordna melodija
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 “Fingerpicking and chord melody” · title

rows.source: One finger per string, rolling patterns, the alternating thumb, and a tune picked from inside its chords.
rows.translation: En prst na struno, tekoči vzorci, izmenični palec in melodija, ubrana iz svojih akordov.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 “Fingerpicking and chord melody” · unit summary
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Rest your thumb on string 4, index on string 3, middle on string 2 and ring finger on string 1. Each one plucks only its own string.
rows.translation: Palec nasloni na struno 4, kazalec na struno 3, sredinec na struno 2 in prstanec na struno 1. Vsak ubira le svojo struno.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Thumb, index, middle, ring: strings 4, 3, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Palec, kazalec, sredinec, prstanec: strune 4, 3, 2 in 1.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Thumb on 4, index on 3, middle on 2, ring on 1: one finger per string.
rows.translation: Palec na 4, kazalec na 3, sredinec na 2, prstanec na 1: en prst na struno.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 4 (along) · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Because string 4 is a high G, the pattern zigzags: high, low, then climbing. That sparkle is the sound of fingerpicked ukulele.
rows.translation: Ker je struna 4 visoki G, gre vzorec cikcak: visoko, nizko, nato navzgor. Ta lesk je zvok ukulele, ubrane s prsti.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: A minor, F, C, G7, in eighths
rows.translation: A-mol, F, C, G7 v osminkah
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 7 (along) · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pluck strings 4, 3, 2 and 1, then come back on 2 and 3: thumb, index, middle, ring, middle, index. Six notes fill a bar of three.
rows.translation: Uberi strune 4, 3, 2 in 1, nato se vrni po 2 in 3: palec, kazalec, sredinec, prstanec, sredinec, kazalec. Šest tonov zapolni tridobni takt.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: After the ring finger plucks string 1, which finger comes next?
rows.translation: Kateri prst sledi, ko prstanec ubere struno 1?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The roll turns around at the top: ring on string 1, then middle on 2 and index on 3.
rows.translation: Vzorec se na vrhu obrne: prstanec na struni 1, nato sredinec na 2 in kazalec na 3.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Land the new chord as the thumb starts the next bar. The fingers keep rolling; only the shape under them changes.
rows.translation: Novi akord postavi, ko palec začne naslednji takt. Prsti še naprej tekoče ubirajo; spremeni se le prijem pod njimi.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: C, A minor, D minor, G7
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 7 (along) · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now the thumb rocks between strings 3 and 4 on the beats while your fingers pluck strings 2 and 1 in between. It's the ukulele's version of Travis picking.
rows.translation: Zdaj palec na dobe izmenjuje struni 3 in 4, drugi prsti pa vmes ubirajo struni 2 in 1. To je različica Travisovega ubiranja za ukulele.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: In this pattern, what does the thumb do?
rows.translation: Kaj v tem vzorcu počne palec?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The thumb keeps the pulse, a note on every beat, while the fingers fill the gaps.
rows.translation: Palec drži utrip, po en ton na vsako dobo, drugi prsti pa zapolnijo vrzeli.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 5 (along) · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 6 (along) · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · title

rows.source: Hold the chord, pick the tune
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In chord melody, your fretting hand holds the chord and you pick the tune from inside it. Hold F, and C, F and A are already under your fingers.
rows.translation: Pri akordni melodiji roka na vratu drži akord, ti pa iz njega ubiraš melodijo. Drži F in C, F ter A so že pod tvojimi prsti.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Hold F: open string 3, string 2 at fret 1, open string 1. That's how Amazing Grace begins.
rows.translation: Drži F: prazna struna 3, struna 2 pri prečki 1, prazna struna 1. Tako se začne Amazing Grace.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: When the tune leaves the chord, reach with a free finger. Over F, finger 3 takes G on string 2, fret 3, then lifts as the tune comes back.
rows.translation: Ko melodija zapusti akord, sezi s prostim prstom. Ob F prst 3 zaigra G na struni 2 pri prečki 3, nato se dvigne, ko se melodija vrne.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: Over B flat, where is the tune's D?
rows.translation: Kje je D iz melodije ob akordu B z nižajem?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: B flat's finger 2 already holds D on string 3, fret 2. The tune walks right through the chord.
rows.translation: Pri B z nižajem prst 2 že drži D na struni 3 pri prečki 2. Melodija gre naravnost skozi akord.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Rolled chords between the verses and the melody inside the chords. The tune is the hymn New Britain, printed in 1829, with John Newton's words.
rows.translation: Tekoče ubrani akordi med kiticami in melodija znotraj akordov. Melodija je himna New Britain, natisnjena leta 1829, z besedilom Johna Newtona.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: Why does the intro's last bar end on a long note?
rows.translation: Zakaj se zadnji takt uvoda konča z dolgim tonom?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: To leave room for the pickup
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The verse starts a beat early, on its pickup. A long last note keeps that beat clear.
rows.translation: Kitica se začne dobo prej, s predtaktom. Dolg zadnji ton pusti to dobo prosto.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · step 5 (along) · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · challenge uke-9-6 “Challenge: fingerpicking” · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · challenge uke-9-6 “Challenge: fingerpicking” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: one finger per string, the out-and-back roll, the alternating thumb and the melody inside the chord.
rows.translation: Brez novosti: en prst na struno, tekoči vzorec naprej in nazaj, izmenični palec in melodija znotraj akorda.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · challenge uke-9-6 “Challenge: fingerpicking” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Thumb, index, middle, ring play which strings?
rows.translation: Katere strune igrajo palec, kazalec, sredinec in prstanec?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · challenge uke-9-6 “Challenge: fingerpicking” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Four public-domain songs arranged for ukulele, and how to lead a room through them.
rows.translation: Štiri pesmi v javni domeni, prirejene za ukulele, in kako skozi njih voditi zbrano družbo.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 “Campfire to stage” · unit summary
Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-1 “Down by the Riverside” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Down by the Riverside, first printed in 1918, is made for singing together. On ukulele it sits in G, with G, C and D7, and a gospel A sharp on string 1, fret 1.
rows.translation: Down by the Riverside, prvič natisnjena leta 1918, je ustvarjena za skupno petje. Na ukulele je v G, z G, C in D7 ter gospelovskim A z višajem na struni 1 pri prečki 1.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-1 “Down by the Riverside” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Down by the riverside: B, B, A sharp, B, then A and G.
rows.translation: Down by the riverside: B, B, A z višajem, B, nato A in G.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-1 “Down by the Riverside” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Cecil Sharp printed this English ballad in 1906. In F it uses F, B flat, C and C7, G minor and D minor, often two to a bar. Pick the chords between verses and let them ring.
rows.translation: Cecil Sharp je to angleško balado natisnil leta 1906. V F uporablja F, B z nižajem, C in C7, G-mol in D-mol, pogosto dva na takt. Med kiticami ubiraj akorde in jih pusti zveneti.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The water is wide: open string 3, F at fret 1 twice, G at fret 3, then open A.
rows.translation: The water is wide: prazna struna 3, dvakrat F pri prečki 1, G pri prečki 3, nato prazni A.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Many bars here change halfway. Count the verse in two-beat halves, one chord each, and change on every other click.
rows.translation: Številni takti se tukaj zamenjajo na polovici. Kitico štej v dvodobnih polovicah, po en akord na vsako, in menjaj na vsak drugi klik.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Before the first strum, count out loud at the song's tempo: one, two, three, four. Everyone starts together, at the speed you set.
rows.translation: Pred prvim potegom glasno odštej v tempu pesmi: ena, dve, tri, štiri. Vsi začnejo skupaj, s hitrostjo, ki jo določiš.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Miss a chord? Keep strumming and catch the next one. A singing room follows the beat, not every note.
rows.translation: Zgrešiš akord? Poteguj naprej in ujemi naslednjega. Pojoča družba sledi ritmu, ne vsakemu tonu.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: You fumble a change mid-song. What now?
rows.translation: Sredi pesmi se zaplete pri menjavi. Kaj zdaj?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Keep strumming and catch the next chord
rows.translation: Poteguj naprej in ujemi naslednji akord
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The beat carries everyone. Drop a chord if you must, never the rhythm.
rows.translation: Ritem nosi vse. Če moraš, izpusti akord, nikoli ritma.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Before the last line, nod or call out last time. Slow the final line a touch and let the last chord ring.
rows.translation: Pred zadnjo vrstico prikimaj ali zakliči »zadnjič«. Zadnjo vrstico malo upočasni in pusti zadnji akord zveneti.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Molly Malone was printed in 1876. It's a waltz: lean on beat 1 and let the tune sway. In F it uses F, G minor, C7, D minor and G7.
rows.translation: Molly Malone je bila natisnjena leta 1876. Je valček: poudari dobo 1 in pusti melodiji, da se ziblje. V F uporablja F, G-mol, C7, D-mol in G7.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In Dublin's fair city: open string 3, F at fret 1 four times, open A, back to F.
rows.translation: In Dublin's fair city: prazna struna 3, štirikrat F pri prečki 1, prazni A, nazaj na F.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which chord pulls hardest back to F?
rows.translation: Kateri akord najmočneje vleče nazaj proti F?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: C7 is the V chord in F. Its seventh leans straight back home.
rows.translation: C7 je akord V v F. Njegova septima teži naravnost domov.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

rows.source: This rowing song is in six-eight: six quick counts to a bar, felt as two big sways. Count 1 2 3, 4 5 6, and lean on 1 and 4.
rows.translation: Ta veslaška pesem je v šestosminskem taktu: šest hitrih štetij na takt, ki jih občutiš kot dva velika zamaha. Štej 1 2 3, 4 5 6 in poudari 1 ter 4.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-5 “The Skye Boat Song” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In six-eight, where do the big beats fall?
rows.translation: Kam v šestosminskem taktu padeta veliki dobi?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-5 “The Skye Boat Song” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-5 “The Skye Boat Song” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-5 “The Skye Boat Song” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-5 “The Skye Boat Song” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Six eighths group in two threes: 1 2 3, 4 5 6. The first of each three carries the sway.
rows.translation: Šest osmink se združi v dve trojici: 1 2 3, 4 5 6. Prva v vsaki trojici nosi zamah.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-5 “The Skye Boat Song” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: No new ideas: four songs, counted in, kept going and finished clean. Play them back to back like a short concert.
rows.translation: Brez novosti: štiri pesmi, jasen začetek, tekoča igra in čist konec. Zaigraj jih zapored kot kratek koncert.

rows.source: From open strings to walking lines and grooves
rows.translation: Od praznih strun do hodečega basa in ritmičnih vzorcev
rows.context: Bass course · course subtitle

rows.source: Meet E A D G, pluck with two fingers, play your first notes and a song.
rows.translation: Spoznaj E A D G, ubiraj z dvema prstoma, zaigraj prve tone in pesem.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 “Hello, bass” · unit summary
Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-1 “Meet your bass” · title
Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-1 “Meet your bass” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The thickest string is the lowest. It sits nearest your face when you play. We call it string 4.
rows.translation: Najdebelejša struna zveni najnižje. Med igranjem je najbližje tvojemu obrazu. Imenujemo jo struna 4.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-1 “Meet your bass” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-1 “Meet your bass” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Strings count from the thinnest (1) to the thickest (4).
rows.translation: Strune štejemo od najtanjše (1) do najdebelejše (4).
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-1 “Meet your bass” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: From thick to thin: E, A, D, G. They match the four lowest guitar strings, an octave down. Try: Every Amp Drives Grooves.
rows.translation: Od debele do tanke: E, A, D, G. Ujemajo se s štirimi najnižjimi kitarskimi strunami, oktavo nižje. Za pomnjenje: Eva aranžira dobro glasbo.

rows.source: Pluck with the pads of your index and middle fingers, taking turns. Rest your thumb on the pickup or on string 4.
rows.translation: Izmenično ubiraj z blazinicama kazalca in sredinca. Palec nasloni na magnetni odjemnik ali na struno 4.

rows.source: Pluck across the string, not up and away. Your finger comes to rest on the next thicker string. This rest stroke sounds full and strong.
rows.translation: Ubiraj čez struno, ne navzgor in stran. Prst se ustavi na naslednji debelejši struni. Tak udarec z naslonom zveni polno in močno.
